summary: Many recent open-weight language models use n-gram embedding tables to improve performance. These tables store learned representations of short token sequences, such as pairs or triples of consecutive tokens, which the model retrieves during processing. However, they can require substantial memory: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, for example, allocates 196 billion parameters to its Engram n-gram memory. We therefore investigate whether this memory cost can be reduced while preserving the performance improvement that the tables provide. We propose storing n-gram embeddings at low precision and systematically investigate different quantization methods and bit allocations across tables. Across nanochat-, Llama-, and GPT-2-family models trained from scratch, four-bit tables save approximately 75% of table memory while preserving more than 99% of the validation-loss improvement from adding the tables. Using fewer bits leads to a larger drop in performance, although we find that a short fine-tuning phase recovers a significant part of this loss. In addition, reinvesting the saved memory in larger tables can improve performance beyond that of the original full-precision tables while still using less memory. These table memory savings also extend to large existing models: on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, low-bit tables save 47-55% of table memory, with perplexity increases of less than 1.2% and largely preserved downstream task performance. These findings establish low-bit precision as a practical way to reduce the memory requirements of n-gram embeddings and use the saved capacity to improve model performance.
title: Low-Bit N-Gram Embeddings for Language Models
title_translated: 低比特n-gram嵌入用于语言模型
summary_translated: 许多近期的开源语言模型使用n-gram嵌入表来提升性能。这些表格存储了短令牌序列（如连续的词对或三元组）的学习表示，模型在处理过程中会检索这些表示。然而，它们可能需要大量内存：例如，DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash为Engram n-gram记忆分配了1960亿个参数。因此，我们研究是否可以在保持表格带来性能提升的前提下降低其内存开销。我们提出以低精度存储n-gram嵌入，并系统性地探究不同的量化方法和各表格间的比特分配策略。在从头训练的nanochat、Llama和GPT-2系列模型中，四比特表格可节省约75%的表格内存，同时保留超过99%的验证损失改善效果。使用更少比特会导致性能显著下降，但我们发现经过简短的微调阶段可恢复大部分损失。此外，将节省下来的内存重新投入更大的表格中，可在仍使用较少内存的情况下实现超越原始全精度表格的性能。这些表格内存节省效果也适用于大型现有模型：在DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash和Qwen3.8-Flash-Next上，低比特表格节省了47%-55%的表格内存，困惑度增加小于1.2%，下游任务性能基本保持不变。这些发现确立了低比特精度作为减少n-gram嵌入内存需求的实用方法，并可利用节省的容量提升模型性能。

summary: Multilingual pipelines such as FineWeb2 apply one recipe across a thousand languages, leaving the failure modes of individual languages unanticipated. We use an LLM once, as a corpus debugger rather than a classifier: a tool-using agent explores the corpus through a read-only, budgeted API and compiles each finding into an executable test, which a native speaker then validates. On the 26.5M-document Slovak portion of FineWeb2, three runs costing \$2.21-\$2.84 each found seven findings over four phenomena. The largest is a machine-generated content farm of 1,408,437 documents (5.32%) that passed the pipeline's filters, 86.6% of it passing even stricter thresholds. Blinded labels support 6 of the 7 findings (defect rates .53-1.00 against .08 in a random control) and do not support one. The compiled suite scans the full corpus in 0.7 s of wall-clock time without a GPU, against \$12k-\$90k per LLM classification pass. The best static sampling baseline validates more selectors than any agent run, at under half the cost. The agent contributes exact prevalence, a precision estimate checked against sampled documents, an account of why the pipeline missed each slice, and a reusable test. We release the framework, Slovak test suite, validation data and agent trajectories.
title: Can an Agent Debug a Web Corpus? Agentic Auditing of Slovak FineWeb2
comment: Accepted to WaC Workshop at EMNLP 2026
title_translated: 智能体能否调试网络语料库？针对斯洛伐克FineWeb2的代理审计
summary_translated: 多语言流水线如FineWeb2对上千种语言采用同一套处理流程，导致个别语言的失败模式未被预料到。我们仅使用一次大语言模型（LLM），将其作为语料库调试工具而非分类器：一个工具使用型代理通过只读且预算受限的API探索语料库，并将每个发现编译为可执行测试，再由母语者进行验证。在FineWeb2的2650万文档的斯洛伐克语部分，三次运行（每次成本2.21-2.84美元）发现了七项结果，涉及四种现象。其中最大的问题是存在一个由机器生成的内容农场，包含1,408,437篇文档（占5.32%），通过了流水线的过滤，其中86.6%甚至通过了更严格的阈值。盲测标签支持其中六项发现（缺陷率0.53-1.00，而随机对照组为0.08），但不支持一项。所编译的测试套件可在0.7秒内扫描整个语料库，无需GPU，相比每次LLM分类需花费1.2万至9万美元的成本大幅降低。最佳静态采样基线在成本低于一半的情况下验证了比任何代理运行更多的选择器。代理贡献了精确的出现频率、经采样文档验证的精度估计、对流水线遗漏每个子集的原因解释，以及可复用的测试。我们已发布该框架、斯洛伐克测试套件、验证数据及代理轨迹。

summary: While monolingual language model (LM) surprisal is widely established as a predictor of reading times, it cannot capture the non-native (L2) reading dynamics that are shaped by the reader's first language (L1). In this work, we investigate whether the cross-lingual transfer within bilingual models aligns with human L1-driven biases during L2 reading. We evaluate bilingual models on eye-tracking data of readers from 12 diverse L1 backgrounds reading English texts. To isolate L1-specific transfer, we compare bilingual models trained on an L1 that matches the readers' L1 background to both a monolingual English baseline and bilingual models trained on other L1s. We demonstrate that matching the readers' L1 improves the prediction of L2 reading times. This predictive advantage is concentrated in late-stage eye-tracking measures, modulated by L1-L2 script overlap, and peaks among intermediate-proficiency readers. These findings provide evidence that bilingual LMs capture aspects of cross-linguistic influence, and that such influence is present in L2 reading behavior.
title: Bilingual Language Models Capture Cross-Linguistic Influence in Second-Language Reading
title_translated: 双语语言模型捕捉第二语言阅读中的跨语言影响
summary_translated: 尽管单语语言模型（LM）的意外性（surprisal）已被广泛证实是阅读时间的良好预测因子，但它无法捕捉受读者第一语言（L1）影响的非母语（L2）阅读动态。在本研究中，我们探讨双语模型内部的跨语言迁移是否与人类在L2阅读中由L1驱动的偏见相一致。我们在来自12种不同L1背景的读者阅读英文文本的眼动追踪数据上评估双语模型。为隔离L1特异性迁移，我们将针对读者L1背景训练的双语模型与单语英语基线以及在其他L1上训练的双语模型进行比较。我们证明，匹配读者L1背景的模型能更好地预测L2阅读时间。这种预测优势集中在后期眼动测量指标上，受L1-L2文字系统重叠程度调节，并在中等熟练度读者中达到峰值。这些发现表明，双语语言模型捕捉到了跨语言影响的部分特征，且此类影响确实存在于L2阅读行为中。

summary: Purpose: To describe an evidence-aware retrieval evaluation protocol for a clinical retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system over breast lesion management literature, addressing the dependence of retrieval scores on annotation coverage. Methods: An 18-document corpus and an 18-query development benchmark, with one Yes/No or WH-question per document, were used. Retrieval combined dense embeddings, BM25, and cross-encoder reranking. Chunk sizes of 128 to 1024 tokens, overlaps of 0 to 20%, and four retriever configurations were evaluated. Relevance was defined by evidence spans mapped to all containing chunks, treating overlapping chunks with equivalent evidence as relevant. Retrieval was evaluated using R-Precision, Recall@K, MRR, and nDCG@K. Separately, generation was assessed on a 512-token index at K=1 to 5 using DeepEval claim-level metrics, with deepseek-v4-pro as the LLM judge, and BLEU/ROUGE metrics. Results: The selected hybrid retriever, using 384-token chunks and 20% overlap, retrieved accepted evidence in the top three results for 17 of 18 queries. Recall@3, R-Precision, MRR@3, and nDCG@3 each reached 0.94. Ground-truth curation increased evidence spans from 25 to 37 and accepted chunk targets from 36 to 51 without changing retrieval rankings. Conclusion: Cross-encoder reranking achieved the highest retrieval scores. Expanded relevance annotations increased recognized evidence without changing rankings, highlighting annotation sensitivity. The small development set and retrieval-informed curation require independent validation, including radiologist assessment of evidence sufficiency.
title: How Ground Truth Shapes Retrieval Scores: Evidence-Aware Evaluation of a Retrieval-Augmented Generation System for Breast Lesions
title_translated: 真实情况如何塑造检索评分：乳腺病变管理文献中检索增强生成系统的证据感知评估
summary_translated: 目的：描述一种针对临床检索增强生成（RAG）系统在乳腺病变管理文献上的证据感知检索评估协议，解决检索评分对标注覆盖度的依赖问题。方法：使用18篇文档的语料库和18个查询的开发基准集，每篇文档对应一个是/否或WH类问题。检索结合密集嵌入、BM25和交叉编码器重排序。评估了128至1024个标记的块大小、0至20%的重叠率以及四种检索器配置。相关性定义为映射到所有包含块的证据片段，将具有等效证据的重叠块视为相关。使用R-Precision、Recall@K、MRR和nDCG@K评估检索。独立地，使用DeepEval的声明级指标在K=1至5时对512个标记的索引进行生成评估，采用deepseek-v4-pro作为LLM评判者，并使用BLEU/ROUGE指标。结果：选定的混合检索器（使用384个标记块和20%重叠）在18个查询中有17个将接受的证据置于前三名结果中。Recall@3、R-Precision、MRR@3和nDCG@3均达到0.94。真实情况的精细化标注使证据片段从25个增至37个，接受的块目标从36个增至51个，但未改变检索排名。结论：交叉编码器重排序实现了最高的检索分数。扩展的相关性标注增加了可识别证据量，但未改变排名，凸显了标注敏感性。小规模开发集和基于检索的标注需独立验证，包括放射科医生对证据充分性的评估。

summary: Accuracy on medical examinations is common evidence offered for the clinical use of language models, yet a health system that intends to run an open model on its own hardware needs to know considerably more: whether the model recognizes when it is likely to be wrong, whether medical fine-tuning improves this ability, whether its correct answers rest on sound clinical reasoning, or whether it actually uses the images it is given. We examine these questions for four open models of 8 to 27 billion parameters on the Spanish MIR residency examination, scoring 1,552 questions from eight editions under the exam's own rules. Answering every question, the three larger models would rank among roughly the first 600 to 3,000 candidates, with 41 to 43 specialties still open to them. Abstention, however, never pays, because even their least confident answers are right more often than the 25% break-even. Medical fine-tuning reduced overconfidence at the cost of accuracy, without improving how well confidence separates right from wrong answers. Moreover, 13-38% of correct answers rejected a distractor for a clinically unsound reason that confidence did not reflect, and removing or swapping the provided contextual images left accuracy unchanged.
title: Would an LLM Match into a Residency? Uncertainty, Reasoning and Image Use of Open Language Models on the Spanish MIR Examination
title_translated: 大语言模型能否通过住院医师考试？开放语言模型在西班牙MIR考试中的不确定性、推理与图像使用分析
summary_translated: 在医学考试中的准确性常被用作语言模型临床应用的证据，但若一个医疗系统计划在其自有硬件上运行开放模型，则需要了解更多信息：模型是否能识别自己可能出错的情况，医学微调是否改善这一能力，其正确答案是否基于合理的临床推理，以及它是否真正使用了所提供的图像。我们针对四个参数量在80亿至270亿之间的开放模型，在西班牙MIR住院医师考试上进行了研究，依据考试自身规则对八届考试的1552道题目进行评分。回答所有问题后，三个较大的模型将位列约前600至3000名候选人之间，仍有41至43个专科可供选择。然而，放弃回答从未带来收益，因为即使是最不自信的答案，其正确率也高于25%的盈亏平衡点。医学微调虽降低了过度自信，但以牺牲准确率为代价，且并未改善置信度区分正确与错误答案的能力。此外，13%-38%的正确答案因临床上不合理的原因排除干扰项，而置信度并未反映这一点；移除或替换提供的上下文图像后，准确率保持不变。

summary: Knowledge graph-to-text (KG-to-text) generation verbalizes a set of knowledge graph triples into fluent natural language. While fine-tuned encoder-decoder models have long been the standard approach, recent LLMs are becoming increasingly competitive. We benchmark recent LLMs against fine-tuned encoder-decoder models, using reference-based metrics and graph-grounded reference-free LLM-based evaluation validated against human annotations. We observed that recent LLMs substantially narrow, and in several settings close, the gap with fine-tuned models on reference-based metrics, while performing better on graph-grounded metrics. LLM-based evaluation scores show limited correlation with reference-based metrics, suggesting that the two approaches capture different aspects of generation quality. Graph-grounded evaluation reveals that prompted models produce fewer contradictions and triple omissions than fine-tuned models, and these errors increase more rapidly with graph size for fine-tuned models, highlighting differences between the two approaches that reference-based metrics may not fully capture.
title: An Empirical Study of Recent Large Language Models for Knowledge Graph to Text Generation on Standard Benchmarks

title_translated: 基于标准基准的大规模语言模型在知识图谱到文本生成中的实证研究
summary_translated: 知识图谱到文本（KG-to-text）生成将一组知识图谱三元组转化为流畅的自然语言。尽管微调的编码器-解码器模型长期以来是主流方法，但近期的大规模语言模型（LLMs）正变得日益具有竞争力。我们通过基于参考的指标和基于图结构的无参考LLM评估方法（经人工标注验证）对近期LLMs与微调编码器-解码器模型进行了基准测试。结果表明，在基于参考的指标上，近期LLMs显著缩小了与微调模型之间的差距，某些场景下几乎持平；而在基于图结构的指标上表现更优。基于LLM的评估得分与基于参考的指标相关性较弱，说明两种方法捕捉生成质量的不同方面。基于图结构的评估揭示，提示模型比微调模型产生的矛盾和三元组遗漏更少，且随着图规模增大，微调模型的错误增长更快，凸显了两种方法之间的差异，而这些差异可能未被基于参考的指标充分反映。

summary: Metaphor is a crucial aspect of human cognition. As such, we would like to understand how it is represented in large language models (LLMs) and how it might be controlled. We use mechanistic interpretability techniques to identify causal subspaces in a range of LLMs covering different architectures and sizes. We show that we are able to steer output on classification tasks across different parts of speech. We are also able to steer output on generation tasks, indicating that these techniques can be used to control the metaphoricity of LLM output.
title: The Geometry of Metaphor: Probing and Steering Metaphor Representations in Large Language Models
comment: BlackboxNLP 2026: The 9th Workshop on Analyzing and Interpreting Neural Networks for NLP
title_translated: 隐喻的几何学：探测与操控大规模语言模型中的隐喻表征
summary_translated: 隐喻是人类认知的重要组成部分。因此，我们希望理解其在大规模语言模型（LLMs）中的表征方式以及如何对其进行控制。我们采用机制可解释性技术，在涵盖不同架构和规模的多种LLMs中识别出因果子空间。我们证明，能够通过这些子空间在不同词性分类任务上调节输出。同时，我们也能在生成任务上实现输出调控，表明这些技术可用于控制LLM输出的隐喻程度。

summary: Users increasingly rely on AI systems for extended, multi-turn tasks, yet evidence indicates that LLM-based system performance degrades over prolonged interaction. To evaluate and improve AI assistants in such settings, we need user simulators that faithfully follow complex user intents while exhibiting realistic conversational behavior. Existing approaches manifest a trade-off: prompted assistants can follow complex user intents but lack behavioral fidelity, while specialized user simulators better approximate conversational behavior but struggle to remain faithful to complex intents. In this paper, we propose a reinforcement learning (RL) recipe that jointly rewards task intent adherence and behavioral naturalness. A crucial contribution of the method is operationalizing naturalness with a lightweight discriminator trained in an alternating, adversarial loop with the user simulator. We release the resulting model, UserLM-2.0, which produces valid simulated conversations (i.e., meeting both task-faithfulness and naturalness criteria) 46.2% of the time, over three times the rate of the strongest prior user simulator (14.1%).
title: Towards User Simulators That Stay On Task And Still Sound Natural
title_translated: 迈向保持任务专注且仍具自然性的用户模拟器
summary_translated: 用户越来越多地依赖AI系统完成长时间、多轮次的任务，但现有证据表明，基于LLM的系统在长期交互中性能会下降。为了评估和改进此类场景下的AI助手，我们需要能够忠实遵循复杂用户意图并表现出真实对话行为的用户模拟器。现有方法存在权衡：提示式助手能较好遵循复杂意图，但缺乏行为保真度；专用用户模拟器更贴近真实对话行为，却难以保持对复杂意图的忠实。本文提出一种强化学习（RL）方案，联合奖励任务意图遵循性和行为自然性。该方法的关键贡献在于通过一个轻量级判别器，在交替对抗循环中对自然性进行操作化定义。我们发布了由此产生的模型UserLM-2.0，其生成符合任务忠实性与自然性双重标准的模拟对话的成功率达到46.2%，超过最强先前用户模拟器（14.1%）三倍以上。

summary: As wearable and digital health systems increasingly generate longitudinal physiological records, communicating these observations in patient-accessible language remains a significant challenge. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a promising mechanism for translating structured clinical information into readable narratives, but this process may introduce semantic drift, where clinically precise meaning is distorted during simplification. We investigate evidence-grounded health summarization for menstrual health monitoring using a constrained generation framework that combines structured evidence conditioning with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) using a prompt-based constrained generation framework. We evaluate semantic alignment using Natural Language Inference (NLI), atomic factuality metrics, and readability measures. Across three LLMs and 4,500 generated summaries, explicit grounding constraints consistently improve clinical alignment, particularly by improving uncertainty preservation and, once faithfulness is evaluated against retrieved evidence, generally preserving or improving faithfulness, while effects on omission remain model-dependent. We also find that improved clinical alignment comes at the cost of increased reading difficulty and medical terminology. These findings highlight the need to jointly evaluate faithfulness, uncertainty preservation, and readability when developing patient-facing medical LLM systems.
title: From Structured Records to Patient Narratives: Preserving Clinical Alignment in LLM-Generated Health Summaries
title_translated: 从结构化记录到患者叙述：在LLM生成的健康摘要中保持临床一致性
summary_translated: 随着可穿戴设备和数字健康系统持续生成纵向生理记录，如何以患者可理解的语言传达这些观察结果仍是重大挑战。大规模语言模型（LLMs）为将结构化临床信息转化为可读叙述提供了有前景的解决方案，但这一过程可能导致语义漂移——即在简化过程中扭曲原本精确的临床含义。我们使用约束生成框架，结合结构化证据条件与基于提示的检索增强生成（RAG），对月经健康管理中的证据驱动型健康摘要进行研究。我们通过自然语言推理（NLI）、原子事实性指标和可读性测量评估语义一致性。在三种LLM和4,500份生成摘要中，显式接地约束始终提升临床一致性，尤其改善了不确定性保留；一旦基于检索证据评估忠实性，总体上保持或提升了忠实性，而遗漏问题则因模型而异。此外，我们发现临床一致性提升伴随着阅读难度和医学术语使用的增加。这些发现强调，在开发面向患者的医疗LLM系统时，必须同时评估忠实性、不确定性保留和可读性。

summary: Recent advances in specialized decision models have expanded the possibilities for zero-shot classification, yet their effectiveness on Vietnamese remains underexplored. This study evaluates four specialized decision models across 13 classification settings spanning six task groups, examining zero-shot performance, sensitivity to label-description language, and robustness to Vietnamese linguistic variations. The evaluation considers English, Vietnamese, and bilingual label descriptions, alongside common linguistic perturbations involving teencode, typographical errors, and diacritic removal. Under English label descriptions, JEV achieves the strongest overall performance, ranking first in 11 classification settings. The effects of label-description language vary across models and datasets, with bilingual descriptions providing no consistent improvement. Robustness experiments reveal that diacritic removal causes the most substantial performance degradation, reducing mean macro-$F_1$ by 9.51--15.47 points across model configurations, considerably more than teencode or typographical errors. These findings highlight the importance of label-description choices and Vietnamese orthographic variation when evaluating specialized decision models for zero-shot text classification.
title: How Well Do Decision Models Transfer to Vietnamese? An Empirical Study of Text Classification
title_translated: 决策模型在越南语上的迁移能力如何？一项文本分类的实证研究
summary_translated: 近期专门化决策模型的发展拓展了零样本分类的可能性，但其在越南语上的有效性仍缺乏深入探索。本研究在涵盖六个任务类别的13个分类设置中评估了四种专门化决策模型，考察了零样本性能、标签描述语言敏感性以及对越南语语言变异的鲁棒性。评估考虑了英语、越南语和双语标签描述，并包含常见语言扰动，如网络用语（teencode）、拼写错误和声调符号删除。在英语标签描述下，JEV整体表现最强，在11个分类任务中排名第一。标签描述语言的影响因模型和数据集而异，双语描述并未带来一致提升。鲁棒性实验显示，声调符号删除导致最严重的性能下降，各类模型配置下平均宏F1值下降9.51至15.47个百分点，远高于网络用语或拼写错误的影响。这些发现突显了在评估用于零样本文本分类的专门化决策模型时，标签描述选择和越南语正字法变体的重要性。

summary: Looped and depth-grown language models reuse computations across depth and have attracted interest for their reasoning capabilities. Building on prior suggestive evidence of improved in-context-learning (ICL), we investigate how such reuse favors ICL, including how it shapes the acquisition, retention, and mechanisms of this ability. Our analysis spans pretrained language models up to 3B parameters and controlled tasks. The experiments provide evidence for a shared inductive bias toward learning from context: grown and looped models rely more on information in context and, compared with a full-depth dense reference, acquire ICL earlier in controlled tasks and retain it more strongly when learning fixed associations in the weights is also possible. Tracing attention heads through training reveals that depth growth propagates early induction heads across layers. Ablations show that grown and looped models rely more strongly on induction-ranked heads for both few-shot performance and later-token prediction. Together, these findings provide evidence for a shared inductive bias toward learning from context and suggest that (soft) parameter reuse shapes how this ability develops and which attention mechanisms support it.
title: How Depth Growth and Looping Shape In-Context Learning in Language Models
title_translated: 深度增长与循环结构如何塑造语言模型的上下文学习能力
summary_translated: 具有循环和深度增长特性的语言模型在深度维度上重用计算，因其推理能力而受到关注。基于先前关于上下文学习（ICL）能力提升的间接证据，我们研究了这种重用如何促进ICL，包括其获取、保持及作用机制。分析涵盖参数量达30亿的预训练语言模型以及受控任务。实验表明，深度增长和循环模型表现出一种共享的归纳偏置，即更倾向于从上下文中学习：相较于全深度密集型参考模型，它们在受控任务中更早习得ICL，并在权重中可学习固定关联的情况下更强地保留该能力。通过追踪训练过程中的注意力头发现，深度增长将早期归纳头传播至各层。消融实验表明，深度增长和循环模型在少样本性能和后续标记预测中更依赖于归纳排序的注意力头。这些发现共同支持了一种共享的从上下文中学习的归纳偏置，并表明（软）参数重用塑造了该能力的发展方式及其所依赖的注意力机制。

summary: Code-switched (CS) automatic speech recognition (ASR) remains difficult because real CS speech is scarce and synthetic speech does not fully match it. We investigate whether synthetic CS speech is more useful for learning an adaptation-friendly initialization than for ordinary continual fine-tuning. We propose SyRA-CS, a pair-specific synthetic-to-real adaptation framework based on Reptile meta-learning. For each language pair and pretrained model, we meta-train on the corresponding synthetic CS-FLEURS subset and then adapt using one hour of labeled real target speech. We evaluate four architectural settings: Encoder-CTC, FastConformer-RNN-T, Attention Encoder-Decoder (AED) and Speech-LLM. Experiments cover on Arabic-, French-, German-, and Hindi-English, against synthetic-only transfer, real-only fine-tuning, and continual fine-tuning. SyRA-CS improves over continual fine-tuning on WER in all 16 model-pair comparisons and on CER in 15 of 16, with relative macro WER reductions of 17.7% for XLS-R and 5.3-5.8% for the other three models. The gains hold across the tested models but vary in size across architectures, language pairs and metrics.
title: SyRA-CS: Synthetic-to-Real Adaptation for Code-Switched ASR with Meta-Learning
title_translated: SyRA-CS：基于元学习的代码切换语音识别合成到真实数据适应方法
summary_translated: 由于真实代码切换（CS）语音稀缺且合成语音无法完全匹配真实情况，代码切换自动语音识别（ASR）仍具挑战性。我们探讨合成CS语音是否比普通持续微调更有助于学习适应友好的初始化。为此，我们提出SyRA-CS，一种基于Reptile元学习的成对合成到真实适应框架。针对每种语言对和预训练模型，我们在对应的合成CS-FLEURS子集上进行元训练，随后使用一小时标注的真实目标语音进行适应。评估涵盖阿拉伯语、法语、德语和印地语-英语四种语言对，对比合成仅迁移、真实仅微调和持续微调三种方法。SyRA-CS在全部16次模型-语言对比较中均优于持续微调，在15/16次中也优于持续微调的字符错误率（CER），XLS-R模型相对宏平均WER降低17.7%，其余三个模型降低5.3%-5.8%。性能提升在所有测试模型中均成立，但幅度因架构、语言对和指标而异。

summary: Multilingual language models can give different identity judgments when the same people's names are written in different scripts. We study this effect using 601 audited identity pairs with attested Devanagari and Latin forms, holding the question and relation fixed. Qwen2.5-7B's same-person accuracy falls from 35.1% in Latin to 8.5% in Devanagari under Marathi prompts, while different-person accuracy remains above 98%. Evaluation across five models reveals distinct response biases, and reduced tokenization fragmentation does not reliably close the gap. Replicating the design on 374 audited Malayalam pairs built from the same entities reproduces the effect in a second script and language family: same-person accuracy falls to 5.3%, about half the matched Devanagari rate, while the margin still ranks matching above non-matching names at 0.925 AUROC. Latin-trained probes recover label information from Devanagari states, exceeding a string-feature baseline under similarity-matched negatives. Scalar calibration recovers 87% of the raw model-probe balanced-accuracy gap, identifying decision criterion placement as a major contributor. Activation patching localises causal sensitivity to the second entity in Qwen's middle layers; one shared sensitivity direction transfers about half the full-state margin correction. A fact-independent intervention at this site raises held-out Marathi same-person accuracy from 6.5% to 33.5%, with 98.5% different-person accuracy. Together, these results distinguish script-dependent discrimination from criterion placement and identify a causal site for improving identity judgments.
title: Same Entity, Different Script: Diagnosing Cross-Script Entity Matching Failures in Language Models
title_translated: 同一实体，不同文字：诊断语言模型在跨文字实体匹配中的失败原因
summary_translated: 多语言语言模型在相同人物姓名以不同文字书写时可能给出不同的身份判断。我们使用601个经审计的身份配对（包含确证的天城文和拉丁文形式），固定问题和关系进行研究。Qwen2.5-7B在马拉地语提示下，同一人准确率从拉丁文的35.1%降至天城文的8.5%，而不同人准确率始终保持在98%以上。在五种模型上的评估揭示了显著的响应偏差，减少分词碎片化并不能可靠缩小差距。在374个由相同实体构建的马拉雅拉姆语配对上重复实验，再现了第二种文字和语言家族中的类似效应：同一人准确率降至5.3%，约为天城文匹配率的一半，但匹配优于非匹配的AUC仍达0.925。拉丁文训练的探测器能从天城文状态中恢复标签信息，优于字符串特征基线；标量校准恢复了原始模型-探测器平衡准确率差距的87%，识别出决策标准位置是主要贡献因素。激活修补定位到Qwen中间层中第二个实体的因果敏感性；一个共享敏感方向可传递约一半的完整状态修正量。在此位置实施无事实依赖的干预，使马拉地语同人准确率从6.5%提升至33.5%，不同人准确率维持在98.5%。这些结果区分了文字依赖性歧视与决策标准放置，并识别出改进身份判断的因果位置。

summary: Continual learning requires a model to keep acquiring new skills and knowledge without compromising its existing capabilities. Parametric methods suffer from catastrophic forgetting and loss of plasticity. Non-parametric methods, such as prompts, skills, and harnesses, leverage in-context learning but are limited by context length and lossy plain-text compression. To effectively combine their complementary strengths, we propose HERD (Harness-Evolving Recursive Distillation), a hybrid continual learning framework that learns efficiently in the harness and internalizes experience into cumulative capabilities via distillation. On the harness side, HERD continually refines its skills to capture reusable patterns, while retaining high-residual examples that the skills fail to capture in a bounded memory. On the parameter side, HERD performs drift-constrained distillation with dual anchors, substantially reducing forgetting over long recursive runs. On the 25-stage task stream of TRACE+17, under fixed memory and compute budgets, HERD matches the strongest parametric baseline in new-task acquisition while exhibiting the least forgetting and the strongest retention of general capabilities.
title: HERD: Harness-Evolving Recursive Distillation for Continual Learning
title_translated: HERD：用于持续学习的Harness-演化递归蒸馏方法
summary_translated: 持续学习要求模型在不损害已有能力的前提下不断获取新技能和知识。参数化方法存在灾难性遗忘和可塑性丧失问题。非参数化方法（如提示、技能、Harness）虽利用上下文学习，但受限于上下文长度和纯文本压缩带来的信息损失。为有效结合二者优势，我们提出HERD（Harness-演化递归蒸馏）——一种混合式持续学习框架，通过蒸馏将经验内化为累积能力，同时高效学习于Harness。在Harness端，HERD持续优化技能以捕捉可复用模式，同时在有限记忆中保留高残差示例；在参数端，HERD采用双锚点约束漂移的蒸馏策略，在长期递归运行中显著减少遗忘。在TRACE+17的25阶段任务流中，固定内存与算力预算下，HERD在新任务学习能力上达到最强参数化基线水平，同时表现出最少遗忘和最强通用能力保留。

summary: Bashkir is a low-resource agglutinative language written in Cyrillic and remains poorly represented in modern LLMs. We present an open resource suite and a systematic benchmark of adaptation methods: the Bashkir Web Corpus (71,567 documents, 46.9M tokens, 16 sources) and three labelled datasets for binary, multiclass and multilabel text classification; the benchmark covers the first two. Experiments use eight architectures (82M-8B: DistilGPT2, GPT-2 base/medium, Phi-3-mini, Mistral-7B, YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B, mBERT, XLM-R) and three adaptation groups (full fine-tuning, QLoRA, in-context learning), plus continual pretraining (CPT). (1) QLoRA on 3.8-8B models outperforms encoder-only fine-tuning on binary classification: YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B with CPT reaches macro-F1 0.748 vs 0.653 (XLM-R) and 0.650 (mBERT); pairwise differences are significant after Holm correction (p<0.001). (2) YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B significantly outperforms Mistral-7B and Phi-3-mini on multiclass classification, BPB and native-speaker ratings (mean 3.28 vs 2.52 and 2.22; n=100; alpha=0.69-0.77; p<0.05); on binary classification its QLoRA advantage is not significant (p>=0.084). (3) CPT effects depend on model and task: perplexity improves for Phi-3-mini (+0.58) and YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B (+0.33) but worsens for Mistral-7B (-1.15, p<0.001); on binary classification CPT helps Mistral-7B most (+4.0 macro-F1). (4) Tokeniser fertility on Bashkir varies 2.67x (2.92-7.80) and tracks adaptation quality, while perplexity across tokenisers is not comparable. Cyrillic tokenisers with Russian pretraining are preferable; LLM judges reproduce native ratings for grammar and coherence (rho=0.33-0.46) but not language correctness (rho=0.16, p=0.11); native evaluation remains necessary. All artefacts are open-licensed.
title: Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of Large Language Models to a Low-Resource Agglutinative Language: A Corpus, Datasets, and a Reproducible Benchmark for the Bashkir Language
title_translated: 大语言模型对低资源黏着语的参数高效适配：巴什基尔语的语料库、数据集与可复现基准
summary_translated: 巴什基尔语是一种低资源黏着语，使用西里尔字母，目前在现代大语言模型中代表性不足。我们发布了一个开放资源套件和系统性基准，用于评估适配方法：巴什基尔网络语料库（71,567篇文档，4690万词元，16个来源）和三个标注数据集（二分类、多分类、多标签文本分类）；基准覆盖前两类。实验涵盖八种架构（82M-8B：DistilGPT2、GPT-2 base/medium、Phi-3-mini、Mistral-7B、YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B、mBERT、XLM-R）和三类适配方法（全微调、QLoRA、上下文学习），以及持续预训练（CPT）。(1) 在3.8-8B模型上，QLoRA在二分类任务中优于编码器-only微调：YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B结合CPT达到宏F1 0.748，高于XLM-R的0.653和mBERT的0.650；Holm校正后差异显著（p<0.001）。(2) YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B在多分类任务、BPB和母语者评分上显著优于Mistral-7B和Phi-3-mini（平均得分3.28 vs 2.52和2.22；n=100；α=0.69-0.77；p<0.05）；但在二分类任务中，QLoRA优势不显著（p≥0.084）。(3) CPT效果取决于模型和任务：Phi-3-mini（+0.58）和YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B（+0.33）困惑度改善，Mistral-7B则恶化（-1.15，p<0.001）；在二分类任务中，CPT对Mistral-7B帮助最大（+4.0宏F1）。(4) 巴什基尔语分词器的词元丰富度差异达2.67倍（2.92-7.80），并与适配质量相关，但不同分词器间的困惑度不可直接比较。带有俄语预训练的西里尔分词器更优；LLM评分与母语者评分在语法和连贯性上相关（rho=0.33-0.46），但在语言正确性上不显著（rho=0.16，p=0.11）；母语者评估仍不可或缺。所有成果均开源许可。

summary: Communicating with the public during an emergency entails issuing warning messages promptly. In Europe, it often requires producing them in more than one language. Recent work has shown that language models can be trained to generate warning messages as a crisis unfolds, but the available data covers only English. To fill this gap, we present CrisiLangs, a multilingual extension of CrisiText (an English dataset of crisis events paired with warning messages written according to expert communication guidelines) to Italian, Bulgarian, German, and Greek. Expert native speakers translated the warning messages of 1,000 events drawn from 411 scenarios, for a total of 5,000 event-message pairs across five languages. We test the resource to fine-tune a multilingual model on all five languages jointly, with and without the emergency guidelines in the prompt, and compare it with a zero-shot baseline. The fine-tuned models outperform the baseline on ROUGE-L, BLEU and BERTScore in every language and configuration. In a human preference study, low decoding temperatures receive the most preferences in all five languages and in both configurations, while the effect of the guidelines varies by language.
title: CrisiLangs: A Multilingual Resource for Crisis Warning Generation
title_translated: CrisiLangs：用于危机预警生成的多语言资源
summary_translated: 在紧急情况下与公众沟通需要及时发布预警信息。在欧洲，这通常要求用多种语言生成预警信息。近期研究显示，语言模型可以在危机发生时生成预警消息，但现有数据仅涵盖英语。为填补这一空白，我们提出了CrisiLangs，即CrisiText（一个根据专家通信指南编写的危机事件与预警信息配对的英文数据集）的多语言扩展，覆盖意大利语、保加利亚语、德语和希腊语。来自411个场景的1000个事件的预警信息由母语专家翻译，总计五种语言共5000个事件-消息对。我们测试该资源，通过联合微调五个语言的多语言模型，并在提示中包含或不包含紧急指南，与零样本基线进行比较。微调模型在所有语言和配置下均优于基线，在ROUGE-L、BLEU和BERTScore指标上表现更佳。在人类偏好研究中，所有五种语言及两种配置下，较低解码温度获得最多偏好；而指南的影响因语言而异。

summary: Most automated survey generation systems retrieve papers as flat documents, limiting their ability to capture research structure. We present SurveyGraph, a framework built around a Methods-Entity Knowledge Graph (MEKG) encoding method-level follow-on, competition, and shared-resource relations. The graph supports core-paper discovery, retrieval, hybrid outlining, and evidence-gated narrative synthesis. We evaluate retrieval, semantic edges, citation grounding, collection coverage, and generation-stage components. In a controlled seven-method equal-budget benchmark, MEKG-anchored fusion balances recall and structural density, with an independent co-citation check. In a separate archived graph-native diagnostic, graph-aware retrieval nearly doubles recall over flat lexical baselines across eight runs (p = 0.004). A semantic evidence gate achieves AUC = 0.75. Audits of 160 generated sentences find 80.6% anchored-or-partial citation support. Human adjudication of 108 stratified semantic edges finds 68.5% supported-or-partial relations (binary-support Cohen's kappa = 0.64), with improves strongest (80.6%) and extends weakest (52.8%). A SurveyBench-facing collection probe reaches mean reference coverage of 0.521 across four topics with an eight-paper budget. Same-backend Qwen diagnostics on a 30-paper/74-relation graph show reduced organization signals when hybrid outlining is removed. Concurrent-system comparisons provide bounded context rather than matched-backend end-to-end evidence. The results position MEKG as an auditable structural layer for typed diagnostics, relation-specific filtering, and controlled survey generation. Code and artifacts: https://github.com/xzzvsxd/SurveyGraph.
title: SurveyGraph: Generating Academic Surveys via Methods-Entity Knowledge Graphs
comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026 Findings. 34 pages including appendices
title_translated: SurveyGraph：基于方法-实体知识图谱生成学术综述
summary_translated: 大多数自动化综述生成系统将论文作为扁平文档检索，限制了其捕捉研究结构的能力。我们提出SurveyGraph，一个围绕方法-实体知识图谱（MEKG）构建的框架，编码方法层面的后续、竞争和共享资源关系。该图支持核心论文发现、检索、混合大纲构建以及证据门控叙事合成。我们评估了检索、语义边、引用定位、集合覆盖率和生成阶段组件。在控制条件下七种方法等预算基准测试中，基于MEKG的融合在召回率和结构密度之间取得平衡，并通过独立共引检查验证。在另一项归档图原生诊断中，图感知检索在八次运行中几乎使召回率翻倍（p = 0.004）。语义证据门控达到AUC = 0.75。对160句生成文本的审计显示80.6%具有锚定或部分引用支持。对108个分层语义边的人工判定发现68.5%得到支持或部分支持（二元支持Cohen's kappa = 0.64），其中改进最强（80.6%），扩展最弱（52.8%）。面向SurveyBench的集合探测在四个主题上以八篇论文预算达到平均参考覆盖率0.521。相同后端Qwen诊断在30篇论文/74个关系的图上显示，移除混合大纲会降低组织信号。并发系统对比提供有限上下文而非匹配后端的端到端证据。结果表明，MEKG可作为可审计的结构层，支持类型化诊断、关系特定过滤和受控综述生成。代码与资源：https://github.com/xzzvsxd/SurveyGraph。

summary: Large language models can repeat an instruction while failing to keep obeying it. We study this recall-compliance dissociation in long-horizon dialogue and define State Integrity Collapse: a model preserves a stated constraint in memory but stops applying it to later turns. We introduce StateTrack-Bench, a controlled suite of conversations covering numerical, format, role/persona, factual-memory, and logical-rule constraints. Across seven provider-pinned model snapshots and five dialogue-depth probes, strict joint retention ranges from 62.4% to 100.0%, with degradation concentrated in symbolic constraints and in one especially brittle model. A forked recall audit shows that 88.6% of observed failures are behavioral-drift failures rather than ordinary forgetting; excluding the brittle outlier preserves this diagnosis (84.4% of failures). Extended evaluations at depths up to 50 turns confirm that the dissociation persists beyond the core benchmark, while Structured State Anchoring recovers up to 24.4 points on immutable constraints. The results show that reliability cannot be inferred from single-turn instruction following alone; evaluation must track whether remembered constraints remain operational as dialogue state grows. Code and artifacts are available at: https://github.com/xzzvsxd/StateTrack.
title: When LLMs Forget What They Believe: Characterizing State Integrity Collapse in Long-Horizon Dialogues

title_translated: 当大语言模型忘记它们所相信的内容：长时对话中状态完整性崩溃的特征分析
summary_translated: 大型语言模型可能重复指令却无法持续遵守。我们研究长时对话中的这种回忆-合规分离现象，并定义“状态完整性崩溃”：模型在记忆中保留了声明的约束，但在后续对话回合中停止应用该约束。我们引入StateTrack-Bench，一个涵盖数值、格式、角色/人格、事实记忆和逻辑规则约束的受控对话套件。在七个提供商固定模型快照和五个对话深度探测中，严格联合保留率范围为62.4%至100.0%，退化主要集中在符号约束及一个特别脆弱的模型。分支式回忆审计显示，88.6%的观察失败属于行为漂移失败而非普通遗忘；排除该异常值后，该诊断仍保持（84.4%的失败）。在长达50轮的扩展评估中确认，该分离现象超出核心基准范围，而结构化状态锚定可在不可变约束上恢复高达24.4分。结果表明，仅凭单轮指令遵循无法推断可靠性；评估必须跟踪记忆约束是否随对话状态增长仍能正常运作。代码与资源见：https://github.com/xzzvsxd/StateTrack。

summary: Hierarchical language generation separates continuous semantic modeling from discrete text realization, but its effectiveness depends on what the latent space compresses and how the discrete generator uses it. We propose Cola2, a framework that jointly studies continuous semantic compression, the balance between reconstruction and generation, and continuous-discrete co-adaptation. Cola2 dynamically segments text into semantic spans, controls the compression rate through auxiliary-loss-free negative feedback, and combines reconstruction and generation supervision to learn compact, predictive latent representations. A block-causal masked diffusion decoder is trained with clean, noisy, and dropped latent conditions, while classifier-free guidance adjusts the balance between semantic reconstruction and autonomous generation. Token-prediction gradients update the encoder through the latents, whereas Flow Matching prior learning is decoupled from representation learning by stop-gradient. During inference, generated text is re-encoded under a fixed span layout to keep the latent history consistent with the actual text context. Experiments on five downstream tasks with about 210 billion training tokens validate the core designs and show competitive, unsaturated scaling. With 346.03 billion source tokens, an unconverged checkpoint reaches a 60.10 average across eight tasks and surpasses Llama-3-8B on HellaSwag and StoryCloze despite its reported pretraining budget being over 43 times larger. These results demonstrate the potential of continuous-latent hierarchical language generation.
title: Cola2: Co-Adaptive Hierarchical Language Modeling with Continuous Semantic Compression and Balanced Discrete Generation
title_translated: Cola2：具有连续语义压缩与平衡离散生成的协同自适应分层语言建模
summary_translated: 分层语言生成将连续语义建模与离散文本实现分离，但其有效性取决于潜在空间压缩的内容以及离散生成器如何使用它。我们提出Cola2，一个联合研究连续语义压缩、重建与生成之间的平衡以及连续-离散协同适应的框架。Cola2动态分割文本为语义段，通过无辅助损失的负反馈控制压缩率，并结合重建与生成监督以学习紧凑且具预测性的潜在表示。采用块因果掩码扩散解码器，在干净、噪声和缺失的潜在条件上进行训练，同时通过无分类器引导调整语义重建与自主生成之间的平衡。令牌预测梯度通过潜在变量更新编码器，而流匹配先验学习通过停止梯度与表示学习解耦。推理时，生成文本在固定段布局下重新编码，以保持潜在历史与实际文本上下文一致。在约2100亿训练标记的五个下游任务上的实验验证了核心设计，并表现出竞争力且未饱和的扩展性。使用3460.3亿源标记的未收敛检查点，在八个任务上平均达到60.10分，尽管其报告的预训练预算超过Llama-3-8B的43倍，仍超越其在HellaSwag和StoryCloze的表现。这些结果展示了连续潜在分层语言生成的潜力。

summary: While LLMs have transformed text generation, standard chat-and-canvas interfaces often reduce human authoring to quite passive supervision, causing review fatigue, over-reliance on AI, and the sidelining of the human role in long-form, source-grounded writing. Prior systems typically address isolated writing phases, leaving comprehensive end-to-end human-LLM collaboration largely unexplored. In this paper, we introduce CoWriter, a proactive agentic scheme that adapts expert human (co-)authoring methodologies from cognitive science to flexibly steer the entire writing workflow while actively encouraging the user to engage. In an exploratory user study, compared to a standard LLM baseline, authors using CoWriter better expressed their perspectives and maintained a higher sense of document ownership, supported quantitatively by $2.2\times$ more successful agent engagements. Furthermore, external reader judges rated the resulting texts higher in "human touch" qualities like storytelling and integrating unique personal experiences. Overall, our results demonstrate that proactively engaging users through established human practices is beneficial for effective LLM-supported co-authoring, providing useful methodologies, techniques and insights for future research on collaborative agents.
title: CoWriter: Guiding Methodological and Synergetic Human-LLM Co-Authoring
title_translated: CoWriter：指导方法论与协同式人-大模型共同写作
summary_translated: 尽管大语言模型已彻底改变文本生成，但标准的聊天与画布界面常将人类作者的角色降级为被动监督，导致审阅疲劳、过度依赖AI，并削弱人类在长篇、基于来源写作中的作用。先前系统通常只解决孤立的写作阶段，使得全面端到端的人-大模型协作仍基本未被探索。本文介绍CoWriter，一种主动代理方案，将认知科学中的专家人类（合）作者方法论灵活应用于整个写作流程，积极鼓励用户参与。在探索性用户研究中，相较于标准大模型基线，使用CoWriter的作者更能表达自身观点，并维持更高的文档所有权感，定量上表现为成功代理互动次数增加2.2倍。此外，外部读者评委对生成文本在“人性化”特质（如叙事能力、融入独特个人经历）方面评分更高。总体而言，我们的结果表明，通过既定人类实践主动激发用户参与，有助于实现高效的大模型支持型协同写作，为未来协作智能体研究提供了有用的方法、技术和洞见。

summary: Memory enables language model assistants to maintain continuity across sessions and generate personalized responses, but knowing more about a user does not necessarily produce responses they prefer. Existing evaluations assess memory capabilities without directly establishing whether memory use benefits the user. To study this gap, we collect approximately 1,000 pairwise judgments from 87 participants using their own ChatGPT queries and personal memories. We find that memory-conditioned responses are not consistently preferred over responses generated without memory and in some cases, users strongly prefer the latter. Automatic evaluators also show limited agreement with users and favor memory-conditioned responses substantially more often than users do. Motivated by these gaps, we introduce a memory-aware reward model that learns from user judgments, achieving 72.8\% preference prediction accuracy and outperforming the existing baselines. Our findings motivate evaluation and optimization objectives that align memory use with the preferences of the people whose information is being used.
title: Memory-Aware Reward Modeling: Learning Human Preferences for LLM Memory Use
title_translated: 记忆感知的奖励建模：学习大语言模型记忆使用的用户偏好
summary_translated: 记忆使语言模型助手能够在会话间保持连续性并生成个性化回复，但了解用户更多信息并不一定带来用户偏好的回应。现有的评估方法在未直接验证记忆使用是否真正有益于用户的情况下，就衡量了记忆能力。为研究这一差距，我们收集了87名参与者基于其自身ChatGPT查询和个人记忆的约1000组成对判断。结果发现，基于记忆的回复并非始终优于无记忆生成的回复，某些情况下用户强烈偏好后者。自动评估器与用户的判断一致性也有限，且比用户更倾向于支持记忆条件下的回复。受此启发，我们提出一种记忆感知的奖励模型，该模型从用户判断中学习，实现了72.8%的偏好预测准确率，并优于现有基线。我们的发现推动了以用户偏好为导向的记忆使用评估与优化目标。

summary: Search is a central component of Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems and has been deeply investigated for classical ASR modeling based on Hidden Markov Models (HMMs). However, in work on current sequence-to-sequence ASR architectures it is often simplified to a small fixed-size beam search without external Language Model (LM). In this work, we present a comparative analysis of search space complexity and efficiency for Connectionist Temporal Classification (CTC) and neural transducer models under different pruning strategies and LM configurations. We show that these end-to-end (E2E) models work with a small search space most of the time but exhibit large temporary peaks in hypothesis count during periods of uncertainty. Score-based pruning dynamically adapts the search to model uncertainty, leading to a significantly lower Real-Time Factor (RTF). Our results highlight the limitations of search with low fixed-size beam pruning and provide practical guidelines for efficient search in E2E ASR.
title: A Systematic Comparison of Search Space Complexity and Efficiency for Time-Synchronous End-to-End ASR Models

title_translated: 面向时间同步端到端语音识别模型的搜索空间复杂度与效率的系统性比较
summary_translated: 搜索是自动语音识别（ASR）系统的核心组件，传统基于隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）的ASR系统对此进行了深入研究。然而，在当前序列到序列ASR架构的研究中，搜索常被简化为固定小规模束搜索，且不依赖外部语言模型（LM）。本文对连接时序分类（CTC）和神经转导模型在不同剪枝策略和LM配置下的搜索空间复杂度与效率进行了对比分析。结果表明，这些端到端（E2E）模型大多数时间运行在较小的搜索空间中，但在不确定性较高的阶段会出现假设数量的显著峰值。基于得分的剪枝能够动态适应模型不确定性，显著降低实时因子（RTF）。研究结果揭示了固定小束宽剪枝的局限性，并为E2E ASR中的高效搜索提供了实用指导。

summary: Clinical Question Answering (QA) underpins Clinical Intelligent Decision Support Systems, but progress is severely limited for low-resource languages such as Indonesian by the absence of public domain-specific data. We introduce IndoNutriQA, an expert-curated Indonesian clinical QA benchmark of 911 question-answer pairs built from real clinical-nutrition reports. Rather than a large-scale training corpus, it is positioned as a high-quality evaluation resource: every pair is grounded in a clinically relevant context, enriched with structured metadata (anthropometric assessment, medical diagnosis, document provenance, chunk segmentation). Eight standardised question types following the Nutrition Care Process (NCP), including the Problem, Etiology, Sign and Symptom (PES) diagnosis statement, are answered for every report, which was written by a graduate-level dietetic intern, by one of three nutritionists. Answers are free-form clinical prose rather than extractive spans, and an expert validation study finds 6-10% of reference answers contestable. The dataset supports generative, extractive and retrieval-augmented QA as well as zero- and few-shot LLM evaluation. We report fine-tuned baselines (IndoBERT variants, mT5, RAG) with 5-fold cross-validation, learning curves and bootstrap 95% confidence intervals, and benchmark eight contemporary LLMs zero- and five-shot. We further calibrate our LLM-as-judge rubric against three expert raters (one RD, two nutritionists), finding it human-comparable on factuality and completeness but unreliable on clinical safety, and a human error analysis shows it misses unsupported content that the raters identify. IndoNutriQA is released to foster research in Indonesian clinical NLP and nutritional decision support.
title: IndoNutriQA: An Indonesian Clinical Nutrition Question Answering Benchmark

title_translated: IndoNutriQA：一个印度尼西亚临床营养问答基准
summary_translated: 临床问答（QA）是临床智能决策支持系统的基础，但由于缺乏公开领域数据，低资源语言如印尼语的发展严重受限。我们提出了IndoNutriQA，一个由专家精心构建的印尼语临床QA基准，包含911个问题-答案对，源自真实的临床营养报告。该数据集并非大规模训练语料，而是定位为高质量评估资源：每一对答案均基于临床相关上下文，附带结构化元数据（人体测量评估、医学诊断、文档来源、段落分割）。针对每份报告，由三位营养师之一根据营养护理流程（NCP）的八种标准化问题类型（包括问题、病因、体征与症状PES诊断陈述）进行回答。答案为自由形式的临床叙述而非抽取片段，专家验证研究发现6-10%的参考答案存在争议。该数据集支持生成式、抽取式及检索增强型QA，以及零样本和少样本大模型评估。我们报告了微调基线（IndoBERT变体、mT5、RAG）的五折交叉验证结果、学习曲线和Bootstrap 95%置信区间，并对八种当代大模型进行了零样本和五样本基准测试。此外，我们将大模型作为评判者的方法与三位专家评审员（一名注册营养师、两名营养师）进行校准，发现其在事实性和完整性上与人类相当，但在临床安全性方面不可靠；人工错误分析显示，模型会遗漏评审员识别出的未经支持的内容。IndoNutriQA已发布，旨在促进印尼语临床NLP和营养决策支持研究。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) serve users whose cultural identities are multi-layered, yet cultural evaluations commonly reduce identity to one label. In this work, we study LLMs under simultaneous identity cues, with a country persona in the system prompt and a second identity signaled in the user turn, either by naming a country (explicit cue) or through the query language (implicit cue). We test World Values Survey (WVS) multiple-choice probing and open-ended sociopolitical generation. In multiple-choice probing, language cues shift answers about three times more than explicit cues but away from the associated country's distribution, and explicit cues do not consistently move answers toward the named country. Across 1.6 million open-ended responses, naming a country closes 30-44% of the gap to the model's own responses for that country, and explicit cues produce more differentiated value changes than language cues. Our results suggest that country and language cues should be evaluated as distinct signals rather than interchangeable proxies for culture.
title: Investigating Multi-Cultural Value Selection Biases in LLMs
title_translated: 探究大语言模型中的多文化价值选择偏差
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）服务于具有多层次文化身份的用户，但现有文化评估通常将身份简化为单一标签。本研究考察在同时存在多重身份线索时LLM的表现，其中系统提示中设定国家身份角色，而用户输入中通过命名国家（显性线索）或使用特定语言（隐性线索）传递第二重身份。我们测试了世界价值观调查（WVS）的多选探测任务和开放式社会政治生成任务。在多选探测中，语言线索导致答案变化的频率约为显性线索的三倍，但方向往往偏离所关联国家的分布；显性线索也未能一致地引导答案向所命名国家靠拢。在160万条开放式响应中，提及国家可缩小30%-44%的差距至模型自身对该国家的回答，且显性线索引发的价值变化比语言线索更具区分性。结果表明，国家和语言线索应被视为独立信号，而非文化替代的等价代理。

summary: Metadata-conditioned generation is often framed as a data-to-text task in which additional input fields should improve grounding. Museum description generation challenges this assumption because catalogue records are heterogeneous, partially visual, and unevenly documented across geographic regions. We study how metadata composition shapes the generation of artefact descriptions through a two-phase framework. Phase 1 analyses natural metadata variation in a large museum collection, where field count, field type, image availability, and Place co-vary. Phase 2 introduces controlled field probes that hold object identity fixed while varying metadata quantity, field type, and image access. Our results show that metadata quantity alone does not explain generation behaviour. Field type determines whether models ground, omit, or infer information, while images can both support visual grounding and increase unsupported interpretation. More broadly, our findings show that metadata-conditioned data-to-text evaluation should assess field- and claim-level support, rather than relying only on aggregate input coverage or reference similarity.
title: When More Metadata Misleads: Probing Field-Level Grounding in LLM-Generated Museum Descriptions
title_translated: 当更多元数据产生误导：探查大语言模型生成博物馆描述中的字段级真实性
summary_translated: 元数据条件生成常被视为一种从数据到文本的任务，认为额外输入字段应提升生成内容的真实性。然而，博物馆描述生成挑战了这一假设，因为目录记录具有异质性、部分视觉性，且在地理区域间记录程度不均。我们通过两阶段框架研究元数据构成如何影响文物描述的生成。第一阶段分析大型博物馆藏品中自然存在的元数据变异，发现字段数量、字段类型、图像可用性与地点之间存在共变关系。第二阶段引入受控字段探测，在固定对象身份的前提下，改变元数据数量、字段类型和图像访问权限。结果表明，元数据数量本身无法解释生成行为。字段类型决定了模型是否真实依据、忽略或推断信息，而图像既能支持视觉真实性，也可能增加未经支持的解读。更广泛而言，我们的研究指出，元数据条件下的数据到文本评估应评估字段级和主张级的支持程度，而非仅依赖整体输入覆盖度或参考相似性。

summary: LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation is increasingly applied to multilingual tasks, yet prompting strategies such as Chain-of-Thought and Role Conditioning are recommended based solely on English benchmarks. Whether their effectiveness transfers across judge models and languages remains unknown: prompt-sensitivity studies are largely English-centric, while existing multilingual judge studies fix the prompt template. In this work, we address this gap by measuring this interaction through a benchmark of 9 prompting strategies, 4 open-weight judges, 27 languages, and 4 tasks across 13 datasets, yielding over 1M pointwise scores on gold-reference outputs, validated against human judgments. We find that prompting strategies are not transferable: the choice of the judge model dominates the choice of prompting strategy, strategy effects reverse direction across judges, and stability degrades in low-resource languages, where these effects are concealed by aggregate reporting. These findings show that prompting effects in multilingual evaluation are conditioned on the judge, task, and language. Consequently, prompting strategies should be validated for the intended evaluation setting, and cross-study comparisons should account for both judge and prompt configuration.
title: Prompting Strategy Effects Depend on the Judge: A Multilingual Study of LLM-as-a-Judge Robustness
title_translated: 提示策略效果依赖于评判者：大语言模型作为评判者的多语言鲁棒性研究
summary_translated: 大语言模型作为评判者（LLM-as-a-Judge）的评估正越来越多地应用于多语言任务，然而目前推荐的提示策略（如思维链、角色设定）仅基于英语基准。这些策略在不同评判模型和语言间的有效性尚不明确：现有提示敏感性研究主要集中在英语，而现有的多语言评判研究则固定了提示模板。本文通过一个包含9种提示策略、4个开源权重评判模型、27种语言和4项任务覆盖13个数据集的基准测试，生成超过100万条基于黄金参考输出的逐点评分，并与人工判断进行验证，以填补这一空白。研究发现，提示策略不具备可迁移性：评判模型的选择远超提示策略的影响，且策略效果在不同评判模型间甚至出现方向逆转；在低资源语言中，这种效应因聚合报告而被掩盖。结果表明，多语言评估中的提示效应受评判者、任务和语言共同影响。因此，提示策略应在具体评估场景中进行验证，跨研究比较应同时考虑评判者和提示配置。

summary: Language models are compared on question-answering benchmarks that pose each question in one wording, and a reworded question can change which of two models scores higher. We ask whether giving the models tools makes such comparisons more stable. An accuracy gain cannot answer this, because tools change several steps between the question and the scored answer at once. We propose a matched protocol that separates those steps: the answer readout, reasoning, the decision to call, the tool's answer, and the report supplied without a call. We apply it to six open models in five domains under five wordings. We find that tools raise accuracy where a program answers the question and widen the wording sensitivity of many pairwise comparisons. The widening follows how often a model calls, and call frequency follows the wording for some models and not others. It also depends on the interface and the instructions: a native tool-calling interface and a second tool description leave no detected widening in molecules, and sensitivity persists where tools return intermediate results. These findings show that deterministic reports do not guarantee stable comparisons. We recommend reporting call frequency and comparison stability under several wordings beside accuracy.
title: Prompt Sensitivity in Tool-Augmented Model Comparisons
comment: 9 pages plus 8 pages of supplementary material; 2 figures and 4 tables in the main text, 2 figures and 5 tables in the supplement
title_translated: 工具增强模型比较中的提示敏感性
summary_translated: 语言模型通常在问答基准上进行比较，每个问题仅以一种表述方式提出，而同一问题的不同表述可能改变两个模型的得分高低。我们探讨是否引入工具能使此类比较更稳定。单纯依靠准确率提升无法回答此问题，因为工具会同时改变从问题到最终答案之间的多个步骤。为此，我们提出一种匹配协议，将这些步骤分离：答案读取、推理过程、调用决策、工具返回结果以及无需调用时的报告。我们在五个领域下对六种开源模型在五种表述方式下进行了实验。结果发现，当程序能直接回答问题时，工具提升了准确率，但同时也扩大了多数成对比较对表述方式的敏感性。这种敏感性的扩大程度与模型调用频率相关，而调用频率对某些模型随表述变化，对另一些则不然。此外，接口设计和指令也起关键作用：原生工具调用接口和额外工具说明可消除分子领域的检测到的敏感性扩大，而在工具返回中间结果的情况下，敏感性依然存在。这些发现表明，确定性输出并不保证比较的稳定性。我们建议除准确率外，还应报告调用频率及在多种表述下的比较稳定性。

summary: Long-context models often use answer-bearing evidence less effectively when it appears away from a prompt boundary. We compare this position bias across Transformer, state-space, and hybrid Mamba architectures by moving one gold document through a fixed set of nine distractors. The evaluated Transformers show a beginning advantage that the evaluated state-space models lack, while both families favor evidence near the end. A matched pure-versus-hybrid Mamba comparison points in the same direction but remains statistically uncertain. The family difference appears among models that can answer the task. Transformer primacy reappears on synthetic retrieval, where state-space ceiling prevents a family comparison. A corpus swap within one state-space architecture changes overall accuracy without a detectable change in curve shape. Prompt changes can create or nearly remove a beginning advantage. Position remains decodable across architectures even when response curves differ, and attention concentration near initial tokens covaries with beginning sensitivity in the tested Transformer family. These exploratory results show that effective context use depends on the evaluated architecture family, capability, task, and prompt, without isolating the sequence mixer as the sole cause.
title: Mixing Matters: Evidence Position Bias Across Sequence Mixers in Long-Context Question Answering

summary: Our previous analysis found that a model's native hashed N-gram table is where continual updates disturb the base least, but its writes needed backpropagation and changed the pretrained table. We present Delta N-gram, a forward-only write path into that table. The pretrained table T^0 is never modified. Evidence is written into a sparse patch Δon the rows it addresses: a 4.1M-parameter writer emits a target and a gate per (position, hash head) event, and a block-averaged delta rule keeps each row a convex combination of its old value and the gated targets. The writer is trained offline on raw text with the pretraining objective; at use time writing takes forward passes only, and clearing Δrestores the original model. A 0.6B prototype trained to answer questions keeps 16/16 facts after a second write; online gradient writes keep 2--4/16. We study two writers: a plain writer that encodes evidence with the T^0-only model, and a delta writer that reads its current memory while encoding. On Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, the plain writer's memory is document-specific: on 64 held-out news events it lowers continuation NLL by 0.068 nats/token against empty memory and by 0.024 against another document's memory, and 0.063 and 0.013 after 16 intervening articles. The delta writer's memory is more document-specific and keeps more of it under distraction (70% vs 54%). Over 35,000 writes on our previous seven-task chain both writers stay stable and the delta writer drifts less (layer-2 math drift 176% vs 188%); later accuracy changes by -0.26/-0.52pp (-7.29pp for gradient updates) and small-k_i drift is 17.9/17.5% (39.2%). Acquisition is negative, and general-input drift reaches 32.8% (20.75%): format rows read by every example grow to 4--12 times their pretrained norm. Zeroing eight such rows removes over 98% of layer-2 drift on math inputs, together with their NLL gain.
title: Delta N-gram: Forward-Only Continual Writing into a Language Model's Native N-gram Memory

title_translated: Delta N-gram：向语言模型原生N-gram记忆中单向持续写作
summary_translated: 我们之前的分析发现，模型的原生哈希N-gram表是持续更新对基础模型扰动最小的位置，但其写入操作需要反向传播并修改预训练表。本文提出Delta N-gram，一种进入该表的前向-only写入路径。预训练表T^0永不被修改。证据被写入其对应行上的稀疏补丁Δ：一个410万参数的写入器在每个（位置，哈希头）事件中发出目标值和门控信号，块平均的delta规则确保每行保持其旧值与门控目标的凸组合。写入器在原始文本上离线训练，使用预训练目标；使用时仅需前向传播，清空Δ即可恢复原始模型。一个0.6B参数的原型模型在回答问题时，第二次写入后仍能保留全部16条事实；而在线梯度写入仅能保留2–4条。我们研究两种写入器：一种是仅使用T^0模型编码证据的普通写入器，另一种是在编码时读取当前记忆的Delta写入器。在Qwen3.8-Flash-Next上，普通写入器的记忆具有文档特异性：在64个保留新闻事件上，相较于空记忆降低延续NLL 0.068纳特/词元，相较于另一文档记忆降低0.024；在16篇中间文章后分别降低0.063和0.013。Delta写入器的记忆更具文档特异性，在干扰下保留更多内容（70% vs 54%）。在之前七任务链上进行超过3.5万次写入，两者均保持稳定，但Delta写入器漂移更小（第2层数学漂移176% vs 188%）；后期准确率下降-0.26/-0.52个百分点（梯度更新为-7.29个百分点），小-k_i漂移为17.9/17.5%（39.2%）。获取为负，通用输入漂移达32.8%（20.75%）：每个示例读取的格式行增长至预训练范数的4–12倍。清零其中八行可消除第2层数学输入上超过98%的漂移，同时消除其NLL增益。

summary: This paper presents a dataset of 121,536 ground-reasons pairs across 86,464 rulings of the five civil chambers of the French Court of Cassation (2016-2025). An appeal on points of law cannot itself be appealed and often decides a case for good. Understanding how the Court rules is thus crucial and can help lawyers who draft those appeals. Inside a ruling, every ground of appeal (a distinct legal complaint against the appealed decision) has its own answer from the Court. This answer is called the reasons and it belongs to one of a few doctrinal families. Using a deterministic pipeline, we pair each ground with its reasons and attach the pair to its family, according to the established French taxonomy. We obtain a descriptive grammar of civil cassation that shows which grounds succeed, which legal texts they refer to, and how both evolve over the decade. We release the dataset, the code and an interactive consultation tool.
title: A Grammar of French Civil Cassation: A Ground-Level Dataset and Tool

title_translated: 法国民事终审法院判例语法：底层数据集与工具
summary_translated: 本文呈现了一个涵盖86,464份法国最高法院民事庭（2016–2025年）判决的121,536对“上诉理由-裁判理由”数据集。法律适用上的上诉本身不可再上诉，常决定案件最终结果。因此理解法院如何裁决至关重要，有助于起草此类上诉的律师。在每份判决中，每个上诉理由（针对被上诉判决的独立法律异议）都有法院给出的专属答复，称为“裁判理由”，属于少数既定教义类别之一。我们采用确定性流程，将每个上诉理由与其对应的裁判理由配对，并根据既定法国分类体系将其归类。由此构建出民事终审判决的描述性语法，揭示哪些上诉理由成功、引用哪些法律条文，以及二者在过去十年中的演变趋势。我们公开发布数据集、代码及交互式查询工具。

summary: Web agents increasingly serve the same user across repeated online tasks such as booking travel, shopping, and scheduling, so their long-term usefulness depends on how well they know the user's preferences. Passive memory and personalization methods cannot obtain preferences the user never reveals, and clarification methods that value a question by its benefit to the current task overlook the benefit of reusing the answer in later tasks. We study Active Preference Acquisition (APA): which missing preferences are worth the cost of asking? We define the Prospective Personalization Value (PPV) of a missing preference as its expected cumulative utility gain over future tasks minus the effort and disclosure-risk cost of asking, and select questions under a per-interaction budget. We characterize when cumulative reuse justifies acquisition despite insufficient single-task benefit, and evaluate this regime with an initial-profile diagnostic. APA computes the counterfactual gain of each candidate preference on public task prototypes with the agent's own task solver and aggregates it by the expected reuse of each task family. We evaluate it on ActiveWebPref, a controlled longitudinal benchmark with hidden but queryable user profiles and exact task utilities. At a horizon of 20 tasks, 34.4% of budget-feasible valuable missing preferences are amortization-dependent; APA acquires 80.3% of them, whereas current-task value of information acquires 5.1%. Under per-user asking-cost caps matched to APA's realized expenditure, APA achieves higher net utility than four heuristic selection baselines. In our cost setting, asking about every unknown preference yields lower net utility than not asking, while APA recovers 84.2% of its utility gain with 27.6% of its questions. The value of acquiring a user preference should account for its reuse across future tasks, not only its benefit to the task at hand.
title: Learning What to Ask for Tomorrow: Active Preference Acquisition for Long-Term Personalized Web Agents
title_translated: 学习明天该问什么：面向长期个性化网络智能体的主动偏好获取
summary_translated: 网络智能体在重复的在线任务（如预订旅行、购物和日程安排）中持续为同一用户服务，因此其长期有效性取决于对用户偏好的了解程度。被动记忆和个人化方法无法获取用户从未揭示的偏好，而仅以当前任务收益为衡量标准的澄清方法则忽略了答案在未来任务中复用的价值。我们研究主动偏好获取（APA）：哪些缺失的偏好值得付出提问成本？我们定义缺失偏好的前瞻性个性化价值（PPV）为未来任务中预期累积效用增益减去提问的努力与披露风险成本，并在每轮交互预算内选择问题。我们分析了累积复用如何在单任务收益不足的情况下仍值得获取，并通过初始配置诊断评估该情形。APA利用智能体自身的任务求解器，在公开任务原型上计算每个候选偏好的反事实增益，并按每类任务的预期复用频率进行聚合。我们在一个受控的纵向基准ActiveWebPref上进行评估，该基准包含隐藏但可查询的用户配置文件和精确的任务效用。在20个任务的预测范围内，34.4%的预算可行且有价值的缺失偏好具有 amortization 依赖性；APA获取了其中80.3%，而基于当前任务信息价值的方法仅获取5.1%。在与APA实际支出匹配的每用户提问成本上限下，APA实现的净效用高于四种启发式选择基线。在我们的成本设定中，询问所有未知偏好反而导致净效用低于不提问，而APA仅用27.6%的问题就恢复了84.2%的效用增益。获取用户偏好的价值应考虑其在未来任务中的复用，而不仅限于对当前任务的贡献。

summary: Speculative decoding is a popular decode acceleration method. As such, it is particularly relevant to long-output generation, which requires an increasingly large KV cache. KV cache compression offers a way to constrain costs in long-context drafting. However, compression methods that focus on prefill information can lose relevance as the output length grows. We term this phenomenon decode staleness and show that it degrades draft model accuracy under selection-based KV cache compression. We introduce RIFT, a family of selection-based KV cache compression strategies that balance prefill information and recent generated tokens. We show that refreshing the KV cache selection during token generation significantly improves the drafter's quality at the cost of additional decode latency. To alleviate the refresh costs, we propose an adaptive KV refresh strategy that reduces the number of score calculations while retaining the drafter's quality. We further demonstrate how a compressibility-driven drafter training phase, based on sparse attention masks, can improve the drafter's quality under a compressed KV cache. Combined with compressibility training, RIFT enables Qwen3.5-4B, drafting for Qwen3.5-122B, to retain over 98% of its full-cache acceptance length on 32K-token inputs, 4K-token outputs, and an 8K-token KV cache budget.
title: RIFT: KV Cache Compression for Draft Models with Complementary Compressibility Training
title_translated: RIFT：具有互补可压缩性训练的草稿模型KV缓存压缩
summary_translated: 推测解码是一种流行的解码加速方法，尤其适用于长输出生成，后者需要不断增长的KV缓存。KV缓存压缩为控制长上下文草稿阶段的成本提供了途径。然而，专注于预填充信息的压缩方法在输出长度增加时会失去相关性。我们将这一现象称为解码陈旧性，并证明它在基于选择的KV缓存压缩下会降低草稿模型的准确性。我们提出RIFT，一类基于选择的KV缓存压缩策略，平衡预填充信息与最近生成的标记。我们发现，在生成过程中刷新KV缓存选择能显著提升草稿质量，代价是额外的解码延迟。为缓解刷新开销，我们提出一种自适应KV刷新策略，在减少评分计算次数的同时保持草稿质量。此外，我们展示了基于稀疏注意力掩码的可压缩性驱动草稿训练阶段，可在压缩KV缓存条件下提升草稿质量。结合可压缩性训练，RIFT使Qwen3.5-4B（作为草稿模型）在32K令牌输入、4K令牌输出和8K令牌KV缓存预算下，保留了超过98%的全缓存接受长度，用于为Qwen3.5-122B生成内容。

summary: Reward models score responses for preference optimization, filtering and ranking, and pooling scores across prompts needs them to be comparable. Yet pairwise evaluation compares two responses to the same prompt, so any score component shared by a prompt's responses cancels and goes untested. We study this component by comparing between-prompt variation in model scores with the same variation in human ratings of the same responses. We propose a human-referenced audit, built from a between-prompt variance share, a sibling-rating regression and prompt substitutions, and apply it to eighteen released scorers and six matched training conditions. We find that scores cluster by prompt more than the ratings do: on HelpSteer2, six reward models have between-prompt shares of 0.34 to 0.64 against a human share near zero. Replacing the original prompt with a fixed instruction keeps substantial clustering but weakens agreement with prompt-level human ratings, so clustering alone does not show agreement with humans. Part of that variation is useful: subtracting prompt means lowers the helpfulness of globally selected responses, and scores stay sensitive to a wrong prompt even when training shuffles prompt means. We propose that reward evaluation check between-prompt variation, sensitivity to a wrong prompt and usefulness for selection separately.
title: What Pairwise Evaluation Misses: Reward Scores across Prompts
title_translated: 成对评估遗漏了什么：提示之间的奖励分数差异
summary_translated: 奖励模型用于偏好优化、过滤和排序，对不同提示的得分进行汇总要求它们具备可比性。然而，成对评估仅比较同一提示下的两个响应，因此提示共享的任何得分成分都会相互抵消而未被检验。我们通过比较模型得分在不同提示间的变异与人类对相同响应评分的变异，研究这一成分。我们提出一种基于提示间方差占比、兄弟评分回归和提示替换的人类参照审计方法，并应用于18个已发布的评分器及6种匹配的训练条件。结果发现，模型得分按提示聚类的程度远高于人类评分：在HelpSteer2数据集上，六个奖励模型的提示间方差占比为0.34至0.64，而人类占比接近零。将原始提示替换为固定指令后，聚类依然显著，但与提示级人类评分的一致性减弱，说明聚类本身并不等同于与人类一致。部分这种变异是有用的：减去提示均值会降低全局选中响应的有用性，且即使训练中打乱提示均值，得分仍对错误提示保持敏感。我们建议奖励评估应分别检查提示间变异、对错误提示的敏感性以及对选择的有效性。

summary: Content warning: this paper quotes slurs and hateful statements from published test suites; the racial slur among them is masked.   Automated systems decide at scale which messages are harmful, and they decide unevenly. Classifiers label African American English as offensive up to twice as often as other English, the accounts of prominent drag queens can score as more toxic than those of white nationalists, and safety behaviour that holds in English collapses in low-resource languages. We argue that over-flagging and under-protection share one cause: deciding harm from vocabulary and surface form rather than from what a message does. We organise the evidence into seven failure modes and argue, as testable hypotheses, that harmful behaviours (a request for secrecy, a demand for payment, an attempt to isolate someone) travel across languages better than the words that express them. We propose an evaluation protocol that makes the gap between the best- and worst-served language communities a headline result, and show that the naive gap is inflated under equal service and that its usual bootstrap interval is unreliable. Applied to five open systems in eleven languages, from a keyword lexicon to two current multilingual guard models, the protocol finds that none reaches native-speaker accuracy at separating harmful function from harmless form (51 of 55 system-language pairs fall short); that greater capability raises discrimination in nine languages while leaving Arabic and romanised Hindi near chance, so the gap between the best- and worst-served languages grows with capability; that one system both over-flags and under-protects the same language most; and that a language a system reads worst can look the most fairly treated when only false positives are reported.
title: Harm Is Behavioural, Moderation Is Lexical: How Language and Culture Decide Whom Automated Safety Systems Protect and Whom They Silence

title_translated: 伤害是行为性的，监管是词汇性的：语言与文化如何决定自动化安全系统保护谁、压制谁
summary_translated: 内容警告：本文引用了来自公开测试集的辱骂性言论和仇恨言论；其中涉及的种族歧视语词已被屏蔽。自动化系统大规模决定哪些消息具有危害性，但其判断存在不均衡。分类器将非裔美国人英语标记为冒犯性高达其他英语两倍，知名变装皇后账号的毒性评分甚至高于白人民族主义者，且英文中有效的安全行为在低资源语言中失效。我们认为过度标记与保护不足的根本原因在于：从词汇和表面形式判断危害，而非根据信息的行为表现。我们将证据归纳为七种失败模式，并提出可验证假设：有害行为（如请求保密、索要付款、试图孤立他人）比表达它们的词语更能跨语言传播。我们提出一种评估协议，将最佳与最差服务语言社区之间的差距作为核心指标，并表明在同等服务条件下，该差距被高估，且通常的自助区间不可靠。应用于五个开放系统在十一种语言中的测试（从关键词词典到两个当前多语言防护模型），该协议发现：没有一个系统在分离有害功能与无害形式方面达到母语者水平（55个系统-语言组合中有51个未达标）；能力越强，在九种语言中加剧歧视，而阿拉伯语和罗马化印地语接近随机水平，因此最佳与最差服务语言间的差距随能力提升而扩大；一个系统在同一语言上同时过度标记和保护不足；一个系统读取最差的语言在仅报告假阳性时反而看起来最公平。

summary: Chunking strategies for retrieval-augmented generation are almost always evaluated on a static snapshot, yet the documents underlying a knowledge base continue to change. Because chunks are embedded independently, a boundary that moves after an edit forces unchanged text to be re-embedded. We measure this update cost on 120 pairs of adjacent Chinese and English Wikipedia revisions for three stateless chunkers (non-overlapping fixed-size, recursive paragraph-first, and content-defined chunking) under a strict byte-identical reuse rule and a frozen dense encoder. On the 116-article common-success pool, with frozen, length-calibrated parameters, fixed-size chunking recomputes 57-68% of its full new-version embedding-input workload, recursive chunking 38-56%, and content-defined chunking 43-54% (it failed on 4 of 62 Chinese articles), while at these parameters mean evidence recall under a fixed 2048-token retrieval budget differs by less than two percentage points within either language. A cost-only parameter grid shows that the ranking of the two content-aware chunkers changes with chunk-length settings, whereas non-overlapping fixed-size chunking has the highest recomputation cost in every length-matched condition. Controlled edits and a verbatim-presence diagnostic support boundary drift as one contributor to recomputation of text already present in the previous version. Update cost is therefore a substantial, parameter-sensitive dimension that static retrieval evaluations do not expose and that should be reported alongside retrieval quality.
title: Chunk Recomputation under Real Document Revisions: Measuring Update Cost and Retrieval Quality of Fixed, Recursive, and Content-Defined Chunking

title_translated: 真实文档修订下的分块重计算：测量固定、递归与内容定义分块的更新成本与检索质量
summary_translated: 用于检索增强生成的分块策略几乎总是在静态快照上评估，然而支撑知识库的文档持续变化。由于分块独立嵌入，编辑后边界移动会导致未更改文本被迫重新嵌入。我们在120对相邻的中文和英文维基百科修订上测量了三种无状态分块器（非重叠固定大小、递归段落优先、内容定义分块）的更新成本，采用严格的字节完全复用规则和冻结的密集编码器。在116篇文章的共同成功池中，使用冻结且长度校准的参数，固定大小分块需重新计算其新版本嵌入输入工作量的57%-68%，递归分块为38%-56%，内容定义分块为43%-54%（在62篇中文文章中有4篇失败）；在这些参数下，每种语言的固定2048-token检索预算内的平均证据召回率差异小于两个百分点。仅考虑成本的参数网格显示，两种内容感知分块器的排名随分块长度设置而变化，而非重叠固定大小分块在所有长度匹配条件下均具有最高重计算成本。受控编辑和逐字存在诊断支持边界漂移是导致已存在于前一版本文本被重新计算的一个因素。因此，更新成本是一个显著且对参数敏感的维度，静态检索评估未能暴露这一点，应在报告检索质量时一并提供。

summary: Single-document LoRA adapters have been proposed as units of knowledge to be merged and retrieved; yet open-book scoring, with the document in the prompt, can credit a document's own adapter (its specialist) for reading that document as readily as for holding it. Training one adapter for each of 150 Wikipedia articles on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, we find that open-book scores mostly measure a reading behaviour every adapter shares: a random adapter trained on another document recovers 82 % of the specialist's open-book advantage over the base model but only 2 % of its advantage on a cloze probe that asks for the same document's facts without providing the source text, a share we cannot distinguish from zero. Content does reach the weights, since the specialists beat the base model in cloze recall by 0.094, and the geometry of their updates follows the documents they read; yet, in a test of 30 queries, adapters chosen by weight-space proximity or text embedding are not distinguishable from random ones on either probe, although that test cannot exclude an advantage of about four fifths of what a query's own adapter gains over a random one. At 16 documents or more, correctly scaled merges recover 87 % to 89 % of the specialists' open-book advantage but only 12 % to 16 % of their cloze advantage, with intervals that run from below zero to at most 32 %, against 94 % for joint training.We also report four silent errors, each of which produced a clean, wrong result.
title: Mostly Reading: What Open-Book Scores Measure in Document-Level LoRA Adapters

title_translated: 大部分阅读：开放书评分在文档级LoRA适配器中衡量了什么
summary_translated: 单文档LoRA适配器被提出作为可合并和检索的知识单元；然而，在提示中包含文档的开放书评分，会同样认可一个文档自身的适配器（其专家）在阅读该文档时的表现，就像认可其持有该文档一样。我们在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上为150篇维基百科文章分别训练了一个适配器，发现开放书评分主要衡量的是每个适配器共有的阅读行为：在一个其他文档上随机训练的适配器能够恢复专家适配器在开放书任务中相对于基础模型82%的优势，但在要求不提供源文本而仅凭事实填空的闭合探测任务中，仅能恢复2%的优势，这一比例与零无显著差异。内容确实进入了权重，因为专家适配器在闭合填空召回中比基础模型高出0.094，且其更新的几何结构与其所读文档一致；然而，在30个查询的测试中，通过权重空间距离或文本嵌入选择的适配器在两种探测任务上均无法与随机适配器区分，尽管该测试无法排除查询自身适配器相对于随机适配器约五分之四优势的可能性。当文档数量达到16个及以上时，正确缩放的合并方法可恢复专家适配器87%至89%的开放书优势，但仅恢复其12%至16%的闭合优势，区间从低于零到最多32%，相比之下联合训练则达到94%。我们还报告了四个沉默错误，每个都产生了看似干净却错误的结果。

summary: Extraction pipelines ask language models for JSON that follows a schema, and the schema can set a minimum number of list entries. We ask what models do when the document holds fewer items than that minimum. Under a preregistered plan, we test eight open-weight models on 558 real documents from nine annotated datasets, with six more models on hosted services as a reference. Three findings stand out. First, models treat the count as a target: a minimum shown in the schema, but not enforced, raises the share of lists longer than the true count from 34.5% to 55.4%. Second, the padding is hard to catch, because most added entries are real text taken from the document; about half of them pass a check that each entry occurs in the source. Third, common fixes help only partly: a line saying fewer items are fine removes the effect on average but misses more true items, a count in prose ("up to k") also raises over-counting, an "N/A" option under an enforced minimum still leaves half the lists padded, and re-asking with the validation error makes padding far more common. We release the code, answer lists and run records at https://github.com/AbhishekBarali/padding-to-k
title: Padding to k: A Minimum Count in the Schema Makes Open-Weight Models Pad Their Extraction Lists

title_translated: 填充至k：模式中的最小计数使开放权重模型对其提取列表进行填充
summary_translated: 提取流水线要求语言模型输出符合特定模式的JSON，而该模式可设定列表条目数量的最小值。我们探讨当文档中的实际条目少于该最小值时，模型会如何应对。在预注册计划下，我们对来自九个标注数据集的558份真实文档测试了八种开放权重模型，并以六种托管服务上的模型作为参考。三个发现尤为突出：第一，模型将该计数视为目标——即使模式中显示的最小值未强制执行，也会使列表长度超过真实数量的比例从34.5%上升至55.4%；第二，这种填充难以察觉，因为大多数新增条目是取自文档的真实文本，约一半的条目通过了“每条条目均出现在源文档中”的检查；第三，常见修复措施仅部分有效：一条说明‘条目更少也可以接受’的语句平均上消除了该效应，但遗漏了更多真实条目；用文字表述的计数（如“最多k个”）也导致过度计数；即使在强制最小值下提供“N/A”选项，仍有半数列表被填充；重新请求并附带验证错误信息反而使填充现象更加普遍。我们已将代码、答案列表和运行记录发布于https://github.com/AbhishekBarali/padding-to-k。

summary: Enthymemes are arguments that leave a premise or conclusion unstated, and they are a common persuasion device on social media. Because readers must fill in the missing part themselves, they often disagree on whether a text contains one. This paper asks how to detect and evaluate enthymemes when such disagreement is part of the task. On tweets about vaccination and immigration, each labeled by five annotators, F1 stalls around 0.67 for every fine-tuned model we train, regardless of data size, added features or label type. We therefore ask how these models should be evaluated instead, and propose metrics that compare predictions with the full distribution of annotator votes, together with a model that predicts this distribution directly and captures disagreement better at no cost in F1. We then ask what role discourse structure plays. Models learn to rely on explicit argumentative structure: they reliably recognize tweets without an enthymeme but rarely commit on tweets that contain one. Both the models and a discourse parser miss arguments whose links are left implicit and must be inferred by the reader. Finally, we discuss what these blind spots mean for content moderation systems trained on majority labels.
title: Interpretive Variation and Discourse Structure in Detecting Enthymemes in Controversial Political Discourse
title_translated: 解释性差异与话语结构在争议性政治话语中识别隐含前提的运用
summary_translated: 隐含前提（enthymemes）是省略前提或结论的论证形式，常用于社交媒体中的说服策略。由于读者需自行补全缺失部分，他们常常对某段文本是否包含隐含前提存在分歧。本文探讨在分歧本身就是任务一部分的情况下，如何检测和评估隐含前提。在关于疫苗接种和移民的推文中，每条文本由五名标注者标注，我们训练的每一个微调模型的F1分数均稳定在约0.67，无论数据规模、添加特征或标签类型如何变化。因此我们转而思考这些模型应如何评估，提出了基于预测结果与标注者投票分布对比的新度量标准，并提出一种直接预测该分布的模型，可在不降低F1的前提下更好地捕捉分歧。接着我们探究话语结构的作用：模型学会依赖显式的论辩结构——它们能可靠识别不含隐含前提的推文，但在含有隐含前提的推文中很少做出明确判断。无论是模型还是话语解析器，都会遗漏那些需要读者推断才能理解的隐含关联。最后，我们讨论这些盲点对基于多数标签训练的内容审核系统的影响。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) often fail to utilise the context given in the input, resulting in hallucinations or a fallback to parametric knowledge. Context augmentation methods aim to improve model performance by modifying the input, from inserting filler tokens that add computational time to adding relevant content such as elaboration of a context during inference. However, these methods have been evaluated in isolation and only by their performance gains, leaving it unclear how they compare and whether they reliably improve performance. In this paper, we present an evaluation framework spanning five methods that differ in how informative the inserted content is and apply them at the sentence level across seven models spanning multiple sizes on three datasets. We find that accuracy gains are not always genuine improvements but undirected perturbations: the methods correct some predictions while breaking others, particularly when the inserted text allows only for more computational time. Our analysis reveals that methods that bring no additional content primarily change model predictions near the decision boundary. Our findings highlight the need to evaluate the reliability of the accuracy gains before adopting them in practice.
title: A Reality Check of Inference-Time Context Augmentation Methods
title_translated: 推理时上下文增强方法的现实检验
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）经常无法有效利用输入中的上下文，导致幻觉或退回到参数化知识。上下文增强方法旨在通过修改输入来提升模型性能，例如插入填充标记以增加计算时间，或在推理过程中加入相关上下文内容进行扩展。然而，这些方法通常被孤立评估，仅依据性能提升，导致其相互比较困难，且难以判断是否真正可靠地提升了性能。本文提出一个涵盖五种不同方法的评估框架，这些方法在插入内容的信息量上有所不同，并在句子级别对七种不同规模的模型在三个数据集上进行了测试。我们发现，准确率的提升并不总是真正的改进，而可能是无方向的扰动：某些预测被修正，另一些却被破坏，尤其当插入文本仅增加计算时间时更为明显。分析表明，不引入额外内容的方法主要改变模型在决策边界附近的预测。我们的研究强调，在实际应用中采纳这些方法前，必须评估其准确率提升的可靠性。

summary: Many language-model pipelines end in a closed-set decision, such as selecting a tool. Prompting a large language model for it is slow and order-sensitive. We ask how small an encoder for such decisions can be and whether it should read the options jointly or separately. In a three-seed study at 32 million parameters, per-option scoring beats joint scoring on a held-out sample of a 37-benchmark decision suite by 5.8 points of chance-corrected skill at matched optimizer steps and by 2.8 at approximately matched training compute; two external benchmarks agree, though not significantly on their unseen tasks. Crossing reader with initialisation shows that the advantage requires a reranker initialisation, whose query-candidate pair input matches per-option reading; from the raw encoder the two readers are indistinguishable. Per-option scoring needs 5 to 13 times more encoder passes: at most twice the median latency, but more than four times the mean. Of six released joint encoders (17 million to 1 billion parameters), the 68- and 150-million-parameter models exceed a 435-million-parameter DeBERTa-v3 zero-shot classifier by 4.9 and 5.9 accuracy points on 209 overlap-audited System1-Arena tasks and are at least on par with it on the 145 tasks unseen in training. The smallest answers a median request in 14 milliseconds on 16 processor threads, against 728 for the classifier. Reordering options changes 12 to 23% of the joint models' answers (per-option scoring: none). Up to 68 million parameters, they lead their size range on a public leaderboard's private, mainly in-distribution tests.
title: Joint or Per-Option? Compact Encoders for Closed-Set Decisions from 17 Million to 1 Billion Parameters
