title_translated: WikiOriginQA：基于知识来源自动构建的问答数据集以分析文化偏见
summary_translated: 现有的文化知识数据集通常由熟悉各文化的真人标注者创建。然而，这一过程需要大量人力，严重制约了可扩展性。为解决此挑战，我们引入WikiOriginQA，一个通过不同维基百科语言版本的创建日期客观表示知识来源而自动构建的问答数据集。使用该数据集的实验结果证实，LLM性能倾向于偏向英语文化。此外，结果表明知识向盎格鲁圈传播的重要性。这些发现验证了我们自动化方法的有效性，使得无需大量人工标注即可在多种语言中实现具有优越可扩展性的文化偏见评估。

summary: Singular-value spectra encode important structure in transformer feed-forward projections, yet their causal role in downstream behavior remains underexplored. We study post-hoc spectral smoothing and spiking interventions on the up_proj and down_proj matrices. Positive perturbation stretches deviations from the geometric mean, making large singular values larger and small ones smaller (spiking), and vice versa. The intervention preserves singular vectors and the geometric mean of the singular values. Across five open Llama and Qwen instruction models, we evaluate the perturbed systems on capability-labeled subtasks, standard and chain-of-thought reasoning benchmarks, judge-scored truthfulness, hallucination, and safety tasks, and TRAIT personality probes. To interpret score shifts, we fit responses in a three-dimensional capability basis consisting of factual knowledge, language understanding, and deductive reasoning. The induced changes suggest structured rather than purely random sensitivity: large positive perturbations more reliably suppress language and deductive responses, moderate negative perturbations can sometimes improve factual or task-local performance on the evaluated grids, and sensitivity varies strongly by model family, benchmark module, and underlying layerwise spectral inequality. These results position spectral perturbation as a lightweight intervention for probing how capabilities are organized and traded off in large language models.
title: Spectral Smoothing and Spiking Perturbations Reconfigure Capability Profiles and Selective Task Performance in Large Language Models
title_translated: 谱平滑与尖峰扰动重构大语言模型的能力分布与选择性任务表现
summary_translated: 奇异值谱编码了Transformer前馈投影中的重要结构，但其对下游行为的因果作用仍待深入探索。我们研究了对up_proj和down_proj矩阵进行事后谱平滑与尖峰扰动的干预。正向扰动拉伸偏离几何均值的程度，使大奇异值更大、小奇异值更小（尖峰），反之亦然。该干预保持奇异向量和奇异值的几何均值不变。我们在五个开源的Llama和Qwen指令模型上评估了扰动系统在能力标注子任务、标准与链式思维推理基准、裁判评分的真实性、幻觉与安全性任务以及TRAIT人格探测上的表现。为解释得分变化，我们拟合响应于由事实知识、语言理解与演绎推理构成的三维能力基底。结果显示，变化具有结构性而非纯随机性：大幅正向扰动更可靠地抑制语言与演绎类响应，适度负向扰动有时可提升在评估网格上的事实或任务局部表现，且敏感性强烈依赖于模型家族、基准模块及底层分层谱不等性。这些结果将谱扰动定位为一种轻量级干预手段，可用于探查大语言模型中能力的组织方式与权衡机制。

summary: Large language models increasingly act as controllers in structured decision pipelines, yet their decisions are still executed by autoregressive text decoding. Hierarchical RAG is one such setting: at each frontier of a document tree, an LLM commits to $b$ of $k$ sections under an input-dependent action grammar, executed as either failure-prone free-form JSON or reliable but strictly serial grammar-constrained generation. We show that this serialization is unnecessary for bounded-horizon control: the reachable future forms a shallow action-prefix tree, which we compile --- one root prefill plus one tree-causal probe evaluate every prefix-conditioned action distribution with serial decoding's tokens, positions, and causal ancestry. A prefix-state lemma makes compiled control policy-exact in exact arithmetic: the same policy with a two-forward critical path and zero output tokens. One further probe pass certifies the exact order-marginalized MAP set. Across four document-disjoint splits and two scales on the primary MetaX device, compiled control matches the serial policy on $84$--$89\%$ of questions --- every instrumented divergence a floating-point near-tie --- and cuts control latency by $35$--$47\%$ versus token-wise serial decoding and $6$--$7\%$ versus an idealized chunked engine; an H800 repetition preserves the ordering.
title: Compiling Autoregressive LLM Control into Policy-Exact Parallel Inference for Hierarchical RAG
title_translated: 将自回归LLM控制编译为策略精确的并行推理以实现分层RAG
summary_translated: 大语言模型越来越多地作为结构化决策流程中的控制器，但其决策仍通过自回归文本解码执行。分层RAG即为一例：在文档树的每个前沿节点，LLM根据输入依赖的动作语法选择k个选项中的b个，执行方式为易出错的自由格式JSON或可靠但严格串行的语法约束生成。我们证明，在有限视野控制下，这种序列化是不必要的：可达未来形成浅层动作前缀树，我们将其编译——仅需一次根预填充加一次树因果探测，即可对每个前缀条件下的动作分布进行串行解码的标记、位置与因果祖先评估。一个前缀状态引理使编译后的控制策略在精确算术下完全精确：相同策略，两条前向关键路径，零输出标记。再额外一次探测可验证精确的顺序边际MAP集合。在四个文档互斥划分及MetaX设备上两个规模的测试中，编译控制在84%–89%的问题上与串行策略一致——所有仪器化偏差均为浮点近似平局——并将控制延迟降低35%–47%（相较于逐标记串行解码）和6%–7%（相较于理想化的分块引擎）；H800重复实验也保持了顺序一致性。

summary: Coding-agent benchmarks often describe a task in natural language but grade it with tests taken from the upstream project. Passing those tests can require information the description never states: a constant's name, a module path, an exact message. We call this a specification-oracle gap: where it exists, a benchmark also measures whether an agent reproduces upstream implementation details. We formalise the gap, including the inconsistencies that chains of dependent tasks add, and build a static audit for five languages that classifies every name-, path- and literal-level dependency of every scored test (held-out precision 89.2%, recall 92.9%). On SWE-Milestone (98 graded milestones, 35 published runs), 25 milestones contain a test that depends on an unstated, non-inferable name or path. Build units with such a dependency fail in 80.6% of runs, against 48.4% for comparable units without one, and withholding a single hidden name from the reference stops its unit's tests from compiling in 126 of 128 cases. The leaderboard's ranking is robust to removing the affected tests, but they shift scores within repositories and favour agents that reproduce upstream names. Across four further benchmarks, prevalence appears to follow construction: a third or more of the tasks are affected where specifications are release notes or LLM summaries, almost none where tasks are screened or written for their tests; how much a gap costs depends on how the harness grades. We release the audit, corrected filter lists and specification addenda.
title: What the Specification Did Not Say: Specification-Oracle Gaps in Test-Graded Coding-Agent Benchmarks
title_translated: 规范未说明的内容：测试评分编码智能体基准中的规范-Oracle差距
summary_translated: 编码智能体基准通常以自然语言描述任务，但使用上游项目中的测试进行评分。通过这些测试可能需要规范中从未提及的信息：常量名称、模块路径或确切消息。我们称这种现象为规范-Oracle差距：在存在该差距的情况下，基准也衡量智能体是否复现了上游实现细节。我们对这一差距进行了形式化，包括依赖任务链带来的不一致问题，并构建了一个针对五种语言的静态审计工具，能够分类每个评分测试在名称、路径和字面量层面的所有依赖关系（保留精度89.2%，召回率92.9%）。在SWE-Milestone（98个评分里程碑，35次已发布运行）中，25个里程碑包含依赖于未说明且无法推断的名称或路径的测试。具有此类依赖性的构建单元在80.6%的运行中失败，而无此类依赖的类似单元仅48.4%失败；从参考答案中隐藏一个隐含名称，会导致其单元在128次中有126次无法编译。排行榜排名在移除受影响测试后仍保持稳健，但会改变仓库内部的分数分布，并偏向于复现上游名称的智能体。在另外四个基准中，差距的普遍性似乎与构建方式有关：当规范为发布说明或LLM摘要时，三分之一甚至更多的任务受到影响；而当任务是为测试筛选或编写时，几乎不受影响；差距的成本取决于评估框架如何评分。我们发布了该审计工具、修正后的过滤列表及规范补充材料。

summary: Industry Foundation Classes (IFC), the standard for building information exchange in architecture, engineering, and construction (AEC), is increasingly queried through large language models (LLMs) using natural language. Evaluating these systems at scale is difficult because free-text answers require costly human or LLM-based review. We propose IFC-MCQ, a method that automatically generates multiple-choice benchmarks from IFC files for exact option-set grading. The taxonomy covers 15 categories and 36 subtypes across four groups, with answer keys derived from the file and distractors constructed from file-derived values or predefined rules. We applied IFC-MCQ to IFC models of varying sizes and modelling characteristics to assess generation coverage and evaluated two agentic configurations on selected models using tool- and code-based retrieval. The evaluation exposed category-specific failure modes and showed that performance can vary with the source IFC model and retrieval interface. IFC-MCQ enables scalable benchmarking of LLM-based IFC retrieval in AEC workflows.
title: IFC-MCQ: Automatically Generating Multiple-Choice Benchmarks for Evaluating LLM Agents on IFC Data Retrieval
title_translated: IFC-MCQ：自动生成用于评估LLM智能体在IFC数据检索中表现的多选题基准
summary_translated: 建筑、工程与施工（AEC）领域中，行业基础类（IFC）标准正越来越多地通过大型语言模型（LLMs）以自然语言进行查询。由于自由文本回答需要昂贵的人工或基于LLM的评审，大规模评估这些系统十分困难。我们提出IFC-MCQ，一种从IFC文件自动生成多选题基准的方法，支持精确选项集评分。该分类体系涵盖15个类别和36种子类型，分为四组，答案键来自文件内容，干扰项则基于文件衍生值或预设规则生成。我们将IFC-MCQ应用于不同规模和建模特征的IFC模型，评估生成覆盖率，并在选定模型上使用基于工具和基于代码的检索方法评估两种智能体配置。评估揭示了特定类别的失败模式，并表明性能随IFC源模型和检索接口的不同而变化。IFC-MCQ实现了AEC工作流中基于LLM的IFC检索的可扩展基准测试。

summary: We present Protegrity-PII, a new PII decision model for structured and unstructured text. Protegrity-PII achieves a typed recall of 0.915 with a precision of 0.907 on a new benchmark we propose, PII-SCOPE. Our model processes text in 0.49 seconds per million characters at \$0.0005 per million characters on a single RTX 6000 using batched inference. Due in part to the expansive nature of the entity type taxonomy used in training, Protegrity-PII achieves superior out-of-distribution generalization when benchmarked against a selection of state of the art models and datasets.
title: Protegrity-PII Technical Report
title_translated: Protegrity-PII 技术报告
summary_translated: 我们提出Protegrity-PII，一种针对结构化和非结构化文本的新PII决策模型。在我们提出的新型基准PII-SCOPE上，Protegrity-PII实现了0.915的类型化召回率和0.907的精确率。该模型在单张RTX 6000显卡上以批量推理方式处理文本的速度为每百万字符0.49秒，成本仅为每百万字符0.0005美元。由于训练中使用的实体类型分类体系范围广泛，Protegrity-PII在多个前沿模型和数据集上的分布外泛化能力表现出色。

summary: LLM judges are used to determine which of two answers is better. Trusting these verdicts requires knowing how repeatable they are and how much they depend on the judge's instructions. We show that similar aggregate scores can conceal substantial changes in individual verdicts, both when the same setup is repeated and when the instructions change. Using 500 Arena-Hard v2.0 prompts with two models' answers held fixed, we run GPT-4.1 as the judge under all eight combinations of criteria, output format and task framing, and repeat every setup unchanged at temperature zero on a pinned model version. Rerunning the default setup moves the aggregate score by about one point but changes the win/tie/loss outcome on 21.2% of prompts. Instruction changes introduce further sensitivity: in one setup, which asks for the verdict without reasoning and also drops several other instructions, outcomes change on 28.2 percentage points more prompts than the two setups' unchanged reruns do on average, and the aggregate score falls by 4.09 points. In another, where the criteria prioritise accuracy, outcomes change on 6.7 percentage points more prompts by the same comparison, while the aggregate score barely moves. A stable aggregate score therefore does not establish that individual verdicts are repeatable. This distinction matters when those verdicts are used as preference labels or to assess individual responses. Evaluations that rely on individual verdicts should repeat each setup they use and report both aggregate scores and prompt-level agreement.
title: Behind Aggregate Scores: What Systematically Varying Arena-Hard's LLM Judge Reveals
comment: Accepted at the JUDGe workshop (Can We Trust the Judge?), NeurIPS 2026 (non-archival). 18 pages, 3 figures. Code and data: this https URL
title_translated: 聚合分数背后的真相：系统性变化的Arena-Hard LLM裁判揭示的问题
summary_translated: LLM裁判用于判断两个回答中哪一个更优。信任这些裁决结果需要了解其可重复性以及对裁判指令的依赖程度。我们发现，相似的聚合分数可能掩盖个体裁决结果的显著变化，无论是在相同设置重复运行时，还是在指令发生变化时。我们使用500个Arena-Hard v2.0提示，固定两个模型的回答，以GPT-4.1作为裁判，在所有八个条件组合（标准、输出格式、任务表述）下运行，并在同一模型版本上以零温度重复每种设置。重新运行默认设置使聚合分数变动约1分，但21.2%的提示改变了胜负/平局结果。指令变化引入了额外敏感性：在一个要求不提供推理且省略多项指令的设置中，结果变化的提示比例比两个不变设置的平均值高出28.2个百分点，聚合分数下降4.09分。在另一个优先考虑准确性的设置中，结果变化的提示比例高出6.7个百分点，而聚合分数几乎未变。因此，稳定的聚合分数并不能证明个体裁决结果具有可重复性。当这些裁决被用作偏好标签或评估单个响应时，这一区别至关重要。依赖个体裁决的评估应重复使用每种设置，并同时报告聚合分数和提示级别的一致性。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used to answer factual questions, but their answers can contain errors and must be fact-checked claim by claim. Yet the resulting score depends on three design decisions: which questions the claims answer, under what conditions each claim is judged, and which sources count as evidence. No existing benchmark specifies all three. We introduce JSFactCheckBench, a Japanese benchmark that specifies all three, with 1,913 claims from LLM answers to questions about misleading information that circulated on Japanese social media, each annotated for factuality at a reference time and for importance to the question, using evidence from preselected Web sources. Across six LLMs, all verify claims directly answering the question less accurately than supplementary claims, a gap that aggregate scores obscure. Scores also drop when models must locate the relevant content in longer or multiple sources and, for all four open models, when the surrounding question and response are added. These weaknesses are visible only because the benchmark records the conditions behind each label. A benchmark that leaves them implicit cannot reveal them.
title: Rethinking the Evaluation of LLM Fact-Checkers
title_translated: 重新思考LLM事实核查器的评估方法
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）被广泛用于回答事实性问题，但其回答可能包含错误，必须逐条进行事实核查。然而，最终得分取决于三个设计决策：所回答的问题、每条陈述的评判条件，以及哪些来源被视为证据。现有任何基准均未明确指定这三个方面。我们引入JSFactCheckBench，一个日语基准，明确指定了这三个要素：包含1,913条来自LLM回答的陈述，这些问题涉及日本社交媒体上传播的误导性信息，每条陈述均在参考时间点标注事实性，并根据其对问题的重要性进行标注，证据来源于预先选定的网络来源。在六种LLM中，所有模型对直接回答问题的陈述验证准确性均低于补充性陈述，这一差距被聚合分数所掩盖。当模型需在更长或多源文本中定位相关内容时，得分也会下降；对于所有四种开源模型，当加入周围的问题和回答时，得分同样下降。这些弱点之所以可见，是因为该基准记录了每个标签背后的具体条件。若基准隐含这些条件，则无法揭示这些缺陷。

summary: Recent advances in search agents have enabled large language models to tackle complex tasks by retrieving and synthesizing external information. However, existing search agents often lack search-state awareness, i.e., the ability to recognize what information has been obtained and what remains missing, leading to hallucinated reasoning and prematurely terminated search. To address this limitation, we propose Self-Assessment Reinforcement Learning (SARL), a reinforcement learning framework in which models learn to recognize their own search state during training and improve their search behavior accordingly, without requiring additional assessment at test time. SARL achieves this through a dual reward design that captures the corrective effect of each assessment while penalizing excessive reliance on it, jointly encouraging effective and efficient search trajectories. Under this setup, SARL achieves a 24.3% relative improvement over the strongest baseline, with average gains of 35.9% on multi-hop reasoning and 27.9% on deep research benchmarks against the strongest per-benchmark baselines. SARL further surpasses methods built on auxiliary supervision or multi-agent coordination, despite operating as a standalone RL framework with no inference-time scaffolding. Beyond final performance, SARL maintains training stability under extended search horizons, a regime where existing methods consistently degrade, enabling sustained gains as task complexity grows.
title: Self-Assessment Reinforcement Learning for Search-State Awareness in Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models
title_translated: 用于检索增强型大语言模型中搜索状态感知的自评估强化学习
summary_translated: 近期在搜索代理方面的进展使得大语言模型能够通过检索和整合外部信息来处理复杂任务。然而，现有的搜索代理通常缺乏搜索状态感知能力，即无法识别已获取的信息和仍缺失的内容，导致幻觉推理和过早终止搜索。为解决这一局限性，我们提出了自评估强化学习（SARL），这是一种强化学习框架，模型在训练过程中学会识别自身的搜索状态，并相应地改进搜索行为，无需在测试时额外评估。SARL通过双重奖励设计实现这一目标，既捕捉每次评估的修正效果，又惩罚对评估的过度依赖，共同鼓励高效且有效的搜索轨迹。在此设置下，SARL相较于最强基线实现了24.3%的相对提升，在多跳推理和深度研究基准上分别取得了35.9%和27.9%的平均增益。尽管SARL作为独立的强化学习框架运行且无推理时支撑结构，但仍超越了基于辅助监督或多智能体协作的方法。除了最终性能外，SARL在延长搜索视野下也保持了训练稳定性，而现有方法在此类场景中表现持续下降，从而支持随着任务复杂度增加而持续提升。

summary: LLM-based chat agents are increasingly used for complex, multi-turn, multilingual medical triage in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), yet evaluation methods focus on single-turn, English-only benchmarks that primarily test the chatbots' knowledge. In practice, users are often confused, overwhelmed, or emotionally vulnerable, giving unclear, misspelled single-word answers or long messages in regional dialects, and the context of a conversation can shift rapidly. We propose SIM-UT (Simulation of User Behaviour for Triage), a multi-turn, simulation-based evaluation method that identifies ecologically valid, contextually relevant failure modes of LLM-based triage chat agents. Using SIM-UT, we evaluated three real-world WhatsApp-based health chatbots: a respiratory screening programme in India, a hearing health support programme in South Africa, and a diabetes and lifestyle coaching agent in Kenya. We compared a medically fine-tuned open model (MedGemma) against general-purpose frontier models (ChatGPT and Claude) across 5,000+ multilingual simulated conversation turns grounded in the personas, constraints, and communication patterns of the real user populations, over 2-4 iterative rounds. A key failure mode emerged in both model families: de-escalation risk. The agents initially identified medical emergencies correctly, but when the user minimised the symptoms without introducing new clinical information, they de-escalated, exhibiting clinically dangerous sycophancy, for example agreeing that vaginal bleeding in pregnancy was "not a problem" or that decreased fetal movements at 32 weeks "can be normal". We recommend user simulation-based behavioural evaluation, grounded in real user context and covering adversarial and edge cases, as standard practice for triage chatbots in production, so that safeguards can be added before deployment or in subsequent iterations.
title: SIM-UT: A User Simulation based Evaluation Framework for Medical Triage Chatbots
title_translated: 基于用户模拟的医疗分诊聊天机器人评估框架SIM-UT
summary_translated: 基于大语言模型的聊天代理正越来越多地应用于低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs）的复杂、多轮、多语言医疗分诊任务，但现有的评估方法主要集中在单轮、仅英文的基准测试，主要检验聊天机器人的知识水平。实际上，用户常常感到困惑、压力大或情绪脆弱，会给出模糊、拼写错误的单字回答，或用地区方言发送长消息，对话上下文也可能迅速变化。我们提出SIM-UT（分诊用户行为模拟），一种多轮、基于仿真的评估方法，用于识别LLM分诊聊天代理在生态有效性和上下文相关性上的失败模式。利用SIM-UT，我们评估了三个实际的WhatsApp健康聊天机器人：印度的呼吸系统筛查项目、南非的听力健康支持项目以及肯尼亚的糖尿病与生活方式教练代理。我们将医学微调的开源模型（MedGemma）与通用前沿模型（ChatGPT和Claude）在超过5000个基于真实用户群体人物设定、限制条件和沟通模式的多语言模拟对话轮次中进行了比较，覆盖2-4轮迭代。一个关键的失败模式在两类模型中均出现：降级风险。这些代理最初能正确识别医疗紧急情况，但当用户淡化症状且未引入新的临床信息时，它们会降低严重程度判断，表现出临床上危险的迎合行为，例如同意妊娠期阴道出血‘不是问题’，或认为孕32周胎儿活动减少‘可能正常’。我们建议将基于真实用户情境、涵盖对抗性及边缘案例的用户模拟行为评估作为生产环境中分诊聊天机器人的标准实践，以便在部署前或后续迭代中加入安全机制。

summary: LLM agents are flexible in language interaction, but using them as long-horizon planners is costly and prone to hallucinated or invalid actions. This paper targets a different role for LLMs: constrained bridges between language and symbolic planning. We propose MemPlan, a memory-conditioned PDDL planning framework for partially observable interactive text environments. MemPlan keeps the PDDL domain fixed and reconstructs the PDDL problem at each step from parsed observations, candidate hypotheses, and interaction memory. Positive graph memory assigns relevance-based action costs to candidate hypotheses for missing objects, locations, or conditions, guiding the planner toward more plausible checks. Negative memory records execution-refuted assumptions and compiles them into exclusion constraints, preventing repeated attempts at candidates already contradicted by feedback. A unified schema-conditioned language--symbol interface, trained offline with supervised fine-tuning, connects text environments to the planning loop through observation-to-fact parsing and symbolic-action-to-command grounding. Experiments on TextWorld, ALFWorld, and Robotouille show that MemPlan improves task completion and step efficiency over language-only and PDDL-aware baselines, while substantially reducing online token cost compared with LLM-planning baselines such as ReAct. The same fine-tuned interface is also reused across TextWorld task types without task-specific fine-tuning. Our code and data are available at: https://github.com/tewiSong/MemPlan.
title: MemPlan: Memory-Conditioned PDDL Planning for Partially Observable Text Environments
title_translated: MemPlan：面向部分可观测文本环境的记忆条件化PDDL规划
summary_translated: 大语言模型代理在语言交互方面具有灵活性，但将其用作长周期规划器成本高昂且容易产生幻觉或无效动作。本文为大语言模型赋予另一种角色：连接语言与符号规划的受控桥梁。我们提出MemPlan，一种面向部分可观测交互式文本环境的记忆条件化PDDL规划框架。MemPlan保持PDDL领域固定，每一步从解析的观测结果、候选假设和交互记忆中重构PDDL问题。正向图记忆为缺失对象、位置或条件的候选假设分配基于相关性的动作代价，引导规划器朝更合理的检查方向推进；负向记忆记录被执行反馈否定的假设，并将其编译为排除约束，防止重复尝试已被证伪的候选方案。一个统一的模式条件化语言-符号接口，通过离线监督微调训练，通过观测到事实的解析和符号动作到命令的映射，将文本环境连接至规划循环。在TextWorld、ALFWorld和Robotouille上的实验表明，MemPlan在任务完成率和步骤效率上优于纯语言和PDDL感知基线，同时相比如ReAct等LLM规划基线显著降低了在线token消耗。相同的微调接口也可跨TextWorld不同任务类型复用，无需针对特定任务进行微调。代码与数据已公开于：https://github.com/tewiSong/MemPlan。

summary: The massively multilingual translation systems that now include Sicilian learned it from noisy, non-standardised web text. To obtain better translation quality, we redevelop the small neural machine translation (NMT) system that Wdowiak customized for Sicilian. We rebuild on maintained software the extraction of the parallel text from the PDFs of the bilingual journal Arba Sicula, whose sentences are aligned by a language-agnostic sentence encoder with thresholds tuned against an existing hand alignment and then filtered for the typical errors of automatic alignment. Furthermore, the tokenization and the desinence-biased subword segmentation of the original system are ported to a Perl-free implementation, and all the results are measured on a frozen test set drawn from the journal. We compare small Transformers trained from scratch with the pretrained NLLB model adapted by low-rank fine-tuning, in both directions and with Italian as a closely related bridge language, and we adapt to the pretrained model the reverse-training recipe of the original system, i.e., a stage on forward-scored back-translations of the web Sicilian followed by a stage on the curated literary text. The pretrained model is by far the better of the two, and the staged training improves the translation into Sicilian more than the translation from it. On the test set of the original system, and in the tokenized space in which it was scored, the staged model with a larger adapter and more back-translations is above the reverse-training recipe in the directions that involve English and below it between Sicilian and Italian. Yet, a multilingual adapter degrades the directions on which it was not trained, which limits its use as a general multilingual model.
title: Climbing the Ladder: Automating Data Pipelines and Reproducing Baselines in Low-Resource Settings
title_translated: 攀登阶梯：在低资源环境下自动化数据管道并复现基线
summary_translated: 如今包含西西里语的海量多语言翻译系统是从嘈杂、非标准化的网络文本中学来的。为了获得更好的翻译质量，我们重新开发了Wdowiak为西西里语定制的小型神经机器翻译（NMT）系统。我们在维护良好的软件基础上，从双语期刊《Arba Sicula》的PDF中提取平行文本，使用语言无关的句子编码器对齐句子，并根据已有手工对齐调整阈值，再过滤自动对齐的典型错误。此外，原系统的分词方式和偏向词尾的子词分段方法被移植到无需Perl的实现中，所有结果均在来自该期刊的冻结测试集上进行评估。我们比较了从头训练的小型Transformer与通过低秩微调适配的预训练NLLB模型，双向翻译并以意大利语作为密切相关的桥梁语言。我们还为预训练模型适配了原系统的反向训练方案，即先在网页西西里语的正向评分反向翻译上训练一阶段，再在精心筛选的文学文本上训练第二阶段。结果显示，预训练模型远优于另一模型，分阶段训练在向西西里语翻译中带来的提升大于从西西里语翻译中的提升。在原系统测试集上，且在原系统评分的分词空间中，采用更大适配器和更多反向翻译的分阶段模型在涉及英语的方向上优于反向训练方案，但在西西里语与意大利语之间则低于该方案。然而，多语言适配器在未训练方向上表现下降，限制其作为通用多语言模型的使用。

summary: Hallucinated citations make it harder to trace sources and verify the evidence behind scientific claims. Detecting them is difficult because bibliographic records can be incomplete or differ across source types and publication versions. A plausible match alone neither validates the citation nor establishes its underlying source. We introduce CiteResolve, a benchmark of 423 real-world hallucinated citations annotated for source recoverability. We further propose CiteAnchor, a source-aware grounding framework that adapts retrieval and field-level verification to each source type and separately determines citation validity and whether a unique source can be recovered. On an existing detection benchmark, CiteAnchor achieves 0.841 F1 with GPT-5.6 Luna and 0.784 with an open-weight backbone, outperforming the baseline with the same backbones by 7.9 and 36.8 points. On CiteResolve, it achieves 74.7% and 70.7% end-to-end task success, outperforming the corresponding web search baselines by 16.3 and 65.3 percentage points. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/oldwizard7/CiteANCHOR_code.
title: CiteAnchor: Source-Aware Grounding for Hallucinated Citation Detection and Resolution
title_translated: CiteAnchor：面向幻觉引用检测与修复的源感知定位
summary_translated: 幻觉引用使追踪来源和验证科学主张背后的证据更加困难。检测这类引用十分困难，因为参考文献记录可能不完整，且在不同来源类型和出版版本间存在差异。仅凭一个合理匹配并不能验证引用，也无法确定其底层来源。我们引入CiteResolve，一个包含423个真实世界幻觉引用的基准，这些引用已标注可恢复性。我们进一步提出CiteAnchor，一种源感知定位框架，根据不同来源类型分别适应检索和字段级验证，并独立判断引用的有效性以及能否唯一恢复来源。在现有检测基准上，CiteAnchor在GPT-5.6 Luna上达到0.841 F1，在开放权重主干模型上达到0.784，分别比相同主干的基线高出7.9和36.8分。在CiteResolve基准上，其端到端任务成功率分别为74.7%和70.7%，分别比对应网络搜索基线高出16.3和65.3个百分点。代码与数据已公开于：https://github.com/oldwizard7/CiteANCHOR_code。

summary: LLMs are increasingly consulted for moral judgment. We aim to improve performance on such tasks by rewarding good arguments, on the premise that arguing well increases the likelihood of judging well. We train a reinforcement learning policy initialized from a state-of-the-art language model in a self-judged tournament with masked thinking: the generated arguments are judged pairwise on argument quality by the policy itself. As an empirical basis, we extract authentic dilemmas from classic novels, using a logic solver to verify that each constitutes a conflict. We show that our judge rates argument quality like human annotators, and the policy then adopts the language register that it rewards. Testing on the external benchmarks MoralChoice, ELEPHANT, and MORABLES, we find that the policy becomes more decisive and invariant to the order in which options are presented, but sycophancy and reframing remain a challenge to validity. Two ablation studies with synthetic dilemmas and unmasked thinking match the reordering gains, but show a weaker register shift and higher sycophancy. We conclude that consistency is not validity: consistency under reordering can be optimized without improving the moral judgment it is meant to signal.
title: Consistency Is Not Validity: Self-Rewarded Moral Argumentation Makes Language Models Decisive but Pliable
title_translated: 一致性不等于有效性：自我奖励的道德论证使语言模型更具决断力但易受操控
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于道德判断任务。我们旨在通过奖励高质量的论证来提升模型在这些任务上的表现，前提是良好的论证能提高正确判断的可能性。我们在一个自评锦标赛中训练了一个基于先进语言模型的强化学习策略，采用掩码思维机制：生成的论证由策略自身进行成对的质量评估。作为实证基础，我们从经典小说中提取真实的道德困境，并使用逻辑求解器验证每个困境均构成冲突。结果显示，我们的评估者在论证质量评分上与人类标注者一致，且策略随后采用了其自身所奖励的语言风格。在外部基准测试MoralChoice、ELEPHANT和MORABLES上，我们发现策略变得更加决断且对选项呈现顺序不敏感，但奉承行为和框架重构仍是影响有效性的挑战。两项消融实验分别使用合成困境和非掩码思维，匹配了重新排序带来的收益，但显示出较弱的语言风格转变和更高的奉承倾向。结论是：一致性不等于有效性——在重新排序下的一致性可以被优化，而不会真正提升其所应表征的道德判断能力。

summary: Training Arabic large language models faces challenges from noisy web data, dialectal variation, and the high cost of continual pretraining (CPT). We introduce AQL-Lite (AQL: Arabic Quality Language), a time- and resource-efficient framework for adapting a multilingual LLM to Modern Standard Arabic (MSA). AQL-Lite couples a quality-first curation pipeline (structural cleaning, heuristic and model-based filtering, MSA selection, and deduplication) with a partial-parameter CPT recipe that trains RS-LoRA adapters across the network together with the last eight transformer blocks and the embedding matrix, under layer-wise learning rates. At a matched 1B-token budget, CPT on AQL-curated data raises a four-benchmark Arabic mean by 3.51 points over CPT on raw web text, which yields no gain over the base model. In a controlled 5B-token comparison, AQL-Lite recovers 94% of the gain of full-parameter CPT (mean 73.19 vs. 73.58) in 52% of the wall-clock time and outperforms adapter-only baselines on every benchmark, and a component ablation shows that adapters, unfrozen blocks, and embedding training each contribute. Scaled to 40B MSA tokens and instruction-tuned on one million examples, the resulting 12B model scores 75.3 on the seven-benchmark Open Arabic LLM Leaderboard v2 (OALL v2) suite. These results suggest that partial-parameter CPT on a carefully curated corpus is a practical route to efficient MSA adaptation.
title: AQL-Lite: Enabling Efficient Knowledge Acquisition for Arabic LLMs via Data-Centric Continual Pretraining
title_translated: AQL-Lite：通过数据驱动的持续预训练实现阿拉伯语大模型的高效知识获取
summary_translated: 训练阿拉伯语大型语言模型面临网络数据噪声、方言差异以及持续预训练（CPT）成本高昂等挑战。我们提出AQL-Lite（AQL：阿拉伯语质量语言），一种时间与资源高效的框架，用于将多语言大模型适配至现代标准阿拉伯语（MSA）。AQL-Lite结合了以质量为先的数据清洗流程（结构清理、启发式与模型过滤、MSA选择及去重）与部分参数持续预训练方案，该方案在分层学习率下联合训练RS-LoRA适配器、最后八个Transformer块及嵌入矩阵。在匹配10亿token预算下，基于AQL筛选数据的CPT相比原始网络文本的CPT提升了4项阿拉伯语基准平均分3.51分，而后者相较基础模型无增益。在受控的50亿token对比中，AQL-Lite仅用52%的时钟时间便恢复了全参数CPT 94%的增益（平均得分73.19 vs. 73.58），并在所有基准上优于仅使用适配器的基线模型；组件消融分析表明，适配器、未冻结块和嵌入训练各自均有贡献。扩展至400亿MSA token并使用一百万条指令微调后，所得120亿参数模型在七项基准的Open Arabic LLM Leaderboard v2（OALL v2）套件中得分为75.3。结果表明，在精心筛选语料库上进行部分参数CPT是实现高效MSA适配的可行路径。

summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have accelerated research on low-resource and multilingual NLP, but their effectiveness in creating an equitable landscape remains unmapped. We analyze 1,158 peer-reviewed open-access papers published between 2020 and 2025, examining research attention to low-resource languages (LRLs) and representation across language and speaker populations. To assess linguistic inclusion beyond publication counts, we introduce the Linguistic Inclusion Framework (LIF), a multidimensional framework that measures linguistic inclusion in four dimensions: research growth, representation expansion, representation continuity, and distributional equity. While annual publications grew from 52 to 415, a 5.4X increase in their ACL Anthology publication share, this growth largely concentrated on represented languages rather than expanding coverage of underrepresented languages. Further analysis shows that languages spoken in Asia account for 64.1% of speakers across LRLs we analyze but receive only 46.7% of the language representation share (0.7X their proportional share), while European languages receive 5.3X their proportional share. At the country level, linguistically diverse regions such as sub-Saharan Africa and Southeast Asia show the lowest language coverage ratios. Applying the framework at the continental level, we find that no region scores well on all four dimensions, showing that research growth alone is not a reliable metric of progress toward equitable and inclusive language technology\footnote{We will release all collected and annotated data for research purposes}.
title: Measuring Research Progress and Linguistic Inclusion in Low-Resource Languages
title_translated: 衡量低资源语言研究进展与语言包容性
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）加速了低资源与多语言自然语言处理的研究，但其在构建公平研究生态中的实际效果尚未明确。我们分析了2020至2025年间发表的1,158篇同行评审的开放获取论文，考察了对低资源语言（LRLs）的研究关注度及其在语言与说话人群体中的代表性。为超越单纯出版数量评估语言包容性，我们提出了语言包容性框架（LIF），从四个维度衡量语言包容性：研究增长、代表性扩展、代表性连续性与分布公平性。尽管年度论文数量从52篇增至415篇，ACL文集中的占比增长5.4倍，但这种增长主要集中于已有代表性的语言，而非拓展对欠代表语言的覆盖。进一步分析显示，亚洲语言在我们分析的LRLs中占64.1%的使用者比例，却仅获得46.7%的语言代表性份额（仅为比例的0.7倍），而欧洲语言则获得其比例的5.3倍。在国家层面，语言多样性高的地区如撒哈拉以南非洲和东南亚表现出最低的语言覆盖率比率。在大陆层面应用该框架发现，没有任何一个区域在四个维度上均表现良好，说明仅靠研究增长无法可靠反映语言技术向公平与包容发展的进展。【我们将公开所有收集与标注的数据供研究使用】

summary: Model fusion aims to integrate the capabilities of multi-expert models into a single model. Existing evaluations offer limited coverage of reasoning with long chains of thought and tool use, while strong average performance can mask substantial losses in individual expert capabilities. We introduce FusionEval, a benchmark that provides controlled expert pools, integrates fusion methods with and without additional training, and offers a unified evaluation suite. The pools contain domain experts independently trained from Qwen3 and Llama base models across math, code, science, instruction following, and tool use. The suite evaluates capability retention and computational cost on eight public benchmarks under comparable data access rules, reporting normalized average and worst performance, runtime, and peak GPU memory usage. Extensive experiments show that training-free methods preserve reasoning performance but substantially degrade tool use at both model scales. In contrast, MOPD preserves tool use and achieves a more balanced capability profile, but requires additional data preparation, inference, and training. Jointly retaining reasoning, instruction following, and tool use at low computational cost remains a challenge. We hope FusionEval supports future research on efficient model fusion that jointly preserves expert capabilities. Our code is available at https://github.com/Baicaihaochi/FusionEval_Benchmark.
title: FusionEval: Benchmarking Model Fusion for Large Language Models
title_translated: FusionEval：大语言模型模型融合的基准评测
summary_translated: 模型融合旨在将多专家模型的能力整合到单一模型中。现有评估方法在长链推理与工具使用方面的覆盖有限，而平均性能优异可能掩盖个别专家能力的显著下降。我们提出FusionEval，一个提供受控专家池、支持有无额外训练的融合方法集成，并具备统一评估套件的基准。专家池包含独立训练于Qwen3和Llama基础模型的领域专家，涵盖数学、代码、科学、指令遵循与工具使用。该套件在八项公共基准上评估能力保留与计算成本，遵循相同的可访问数据规则，报告归一化平均与最差性能、运行时间与峰值GPU内存使用量。大量实验表明，无需训练的方法虽能保持推理性能，但在两个模型规模下均显著损害工具使用能力；相比之下，MOPD方法保留了工具使用能力并实现了更均衡的能力分布，但需要额外的数据准备、推理与训练。在低计算成本下同时保留推理、指令遵循与工具使用能力仍是挑战。我们希望FusionEval能推动未来高效模型融合研究，共同保留专家能力。代码已开源：https://github.com/Baicaihaochi/FusionEval_Benchmark。

summary: Many Indian banks serve customers through FAQ pages and scripted chatbots. Assistants based on language models could respond faster and carry out requests such as blocking a card, but only if they give correct information and follow the bank's rules. These rules prescribe a procedure, a set of required steps, such as obtaining a closure quote before closing a deposit. Adapting models to this domain requires measuring how well they follow the procedure, before and after training. Benchmarks usually judge only the records left at the end of a conversation. Many required steps, however, leave the records unchanged, so an assistant that skips them can still be judged successful. We present TauIndianBankBench, an action-oriented benchmark of 1,000 Indian retail-banking tasks where an assistant helps a simulated customer. Besides the final records, it checks that the assistant took every required step and made no unrequested change. For every model, 6.5-12.0% of sessions are judged successful when only the final records are checked, although the assistant skipped a required step or made an unrequested change. Scoring both procedure and outcome shows more accurately how well language models perform in Indian retail banking.
title: TauIndianBankBench: Procedure-Aware, Action-Oriented Evaluation of Tool-Using Conversational Agents
comment: 15 pages, 6 figures, 14 tables. Code: this https URL data: this https URL
title_translated: TauIndianBankBench：面向工具使用对话智能体的程序感知、动作导向评估
summary_translated: 许多印度银行通过FAQ页面和脚本化聊天机器人服务客户。基于语言模型的助手可更快响应并执行如挂失卡片等请求，但前提是它们必须提供正确信息并遵守银行规则。这些规则规定了特定流程——一系列必要步骤，例如在关闭存款账户前需获取结清证明。将模型适配至该领域需衡量其在训练前后对流程的遵循程度。现有基准通常仅评估对话结束时的记录。然而，许多必要步骤并不会改变记录状态，因此跳过这些步骤的助手仍可能被判定为成功。我们提出TauIndianBankBench，一个包含1,000个印度零售银行业务任务的动作导向基准，其中助手协助模拟客户完成任务。除了最终记录外，该基准还检查助手是否执行了每一项必要步骤且未进行任何未经请求的更改。对于每个模型，若仅检查最终记录，6.5%-12.0%的会话会被判定为成功，尽管助手跳过了必要步骤或进行了未经授权的操作。同时评估流程与结果能更准确地反映语言模型在印度零售银行场景中的实际表现。

summary: Artificial intelligence (AI), as a decision-support aid, provides new tools for studying history effectively using multimodal data, including text, images, and audio. We present, to our knowledge, the first digital assistant named Lighthouse--commonly called a chatbot--for exploring the Civil Rights period of the United States using data from South Carolina. From an AI perspective, the system's novelty lies in its guiding design principles of (a) focusing on trustworthiness of content and (b) by modeling and reducing potential harm to users from generated answers. It implements these with a neuro-symbolic approach that combines neural learning through a large language model (LLM) with rule-based symbolic solving, balancing risk of answers with generality of coverage. We evaluate Lighthouse with both factual objective questions that admit a single acceptable answer as well as subjective questions. For the latter, a dataset of subjective question-answer pairs (QAs) is created by discovering a "gold standard" by aggregating answers from independent experts. Lighthouse has access to over 18k primary sources from a range of collections and can be easily extended.
title: Lighthouse: On Building a Trustworthy Digital Assistant for Exploring History with Civil Rights Archives
title_translated: Lighthouse：构建一个值得信赖的数字助手以探索民权档案中的历史
summary_translated: 人工智能（AI）作为决策支持工具，为利用包括文本、图像和音频在内的多模态数据有效研究历史提供了新方法。我们提出，据我们所知，首个名为Lighthouse的数字助手——通常称为聊天机器人——用于使用南卡罗来纳州的数据探索美国民权时期的历史。从AI角度来看，该系统的新颖性在于其指导设计原则：（a）关注内容的可信度；（b）建模并减少生成答案对用户可能造成的潜在伤害。它通过神经符号方法实现这些目标，将大型语言模型（LLM）的神经学习与基于规则的符号求解相结合，在答案风险与覆盖广度之间取得平衡。我们通过事实性客观问题（有唯一可接受答案）以及主观问题对Lighthouse进行了评估。对于后者，我们通过独立专家的答案聚合发现‘黄金标准’，创建了一个主观问答对数据集。Lighthouse可访问超过18,000份来自多个资料库的一手资料，并且易于扩展。

summary: Nonlinear recurrent networks remain useful for streaming sequence modeling, yet gated cell design is still dominated by LSTM and GRU. We study whether recurrent computation can be reallocated away from gate transforms and toward candidate generation. We propose baseVultra, a compact recurrent cell that concentrates the dense recurrent budget on a single H x H candidate-generation matrix, while replacing recurrent gate matrices with O(H) diagonal interactions. The candidate update combines this dense branch with two low-rank auxiliary branches, an EMA cache, and learnable output blending; the gates additionally receive lightweight second-order access to h_{t-2} through diagonal terms. On TinyShakespeare character-level language modeling, baseVultra achieves a validation loss of 1.594 in the compact one-layer 200K setting, compared with 1.604 for a parameter-matched LSTM and 1.616 for a parameter-matched GRU, while its dense recurrent matrix-vector computation is about 54% of GRU under matched hidden size for this configuration. On text8, a roughly 45x larger benchmark, baseVultra is competitive with full-gate cells (1.854 bpc vs. 1.849 for GRU and 1.837 for LSTM). On formal-language probes, the largest gains appear under constrained hidden-state capacity (0.991 vs. 0.761 GRU and 0.691 LSTM OOD2 accuracy on Counter at H=16) and vanish as hidden size grows. These results characterize where and when candidate-focused recurrent capacity allocation helps: the benefit is concentrated in compact regimes, while full-gate cells remain competitive at scale.
title: baseVultra: Compact Nonlinear Recurrence with Reallocated Capacity
comment: Preprint. 14 pages, 3 figures. Revised based on peer review feedback from WAIC Academic 2026 (1 weak accept, 2 borderline)
title_translated: baseVultra：具有重新分配容量的紧凑非线性递归结构
summary_translated: 非线性递归网络在流式序列建模中仍然有用，但门控单元设计仍主要由LSTM和GRU主导。我们研究是否可以将递归计算从门变换转移到候选生成上。我们提出了baseVultra，一种紧凑的递归单元，将密集递归预算集中在单一H×H候选生成矩阵上，同时用O(H)的对角交互替代递归门矩阵。候选更新结合了这一密集分支与两个低秩辅助分支、EMA缓存以及可学习的输出融合；门还通过对角项获得轻量级的二阶h_{t-2}访问。在TinyShakespeare字符级语言建模任务中，baseVultra在单层20万参数设置下达到验证损失1.594，优于参数匹配的LSTM（1.604）和GRU（1.616），且其密集递归矩阵向量运算量约为相同隐藏尺寸下GRU的54%。在更大的text8基准（约45倍大）上，baseVultra与全门控单元相当（1.854 bpc vs. GRU 1.849 和 LSTM 1.837）。在形式语言探测任务中，最大收益出现在受限隐藏状态容量下（Counter任务在H=16时，baseVultra OOD2准确率为0.991，GRU为0.761，LSTM为0.691），随着隐藏尺寸增大而消失。这些结果揭示了候选聚焦递归容量分配的适用场景：优势集中于紧凑配置，而全门控单元在大规模下仍具竞争力。

summary: Test-time scaling has emerged as a key inference strategy for reasoning models, where a model generates a large number of candidate solutions in the hope of finding at least one correct solution. Running all candidate solutions to completion can be computationally demanding, so recent work prunes the candidate pool after generating only a short prefix, committing further computation only to the surviving candidates. Existing pruning strategies divide broadly into two categories: Quality-based methods assign a score to each partial solution and discard those predicted to ultimately lead to an incorrect final solution, while diversity-based methods select partial solutions that follow different reasoning trajectories and are therefore likely to cover different final solutions. The tension between these two objectives is an instance of exploration versus exploitation, yet little to no prior work on pruning exposes this trade-off directly, let alone optimizes it. In this paper, we introduce a pruning procedure that addresses this trade-off directly by optimizing pass@$k$ over the selected solution pool. In particular, it chooses the pool to maximize the probability that at least one of its partial solutions, when continued to completion, yields a correct answer. Because this objective simultaneously rewards high-quality partial solutions and penalizes redundancy among them, quality and diversity are naturally balanced by the criterion itself rather than through separate ad-hoc design choices. On eight open-weight reasoning models, our method outperforms existing quality-based and diversity-based pruning strategies. The gains are particularly pronounced when the pruning procedure keeps a moderate number of partial solutions for continued generation, highlighting the value of directly balancing quality and diversity during pruning.
title: Direct Pass@$k$ Optimization for Thought Pruning: Balancing Quality and Diversity in Test-Time Reasoning
title_translated: 直接优化Pass@$k$以实现思维剪枝：在测试时推理中平衡质量与多样性
summary_translated: 测试时缩放已成为推理模型的关键推理策略，即模型生成大量候选解，以期至少找到一个正确解。完整运行所有候选解计算成本高昂，因此近期工作仅在生成短前缀后对候选池进行剪枝，仅对幸存候选继续投入计算。现有剪枝策略大致分为两类：基于质量的方法为每个部分解分配分数，并丢弃那些预测最终会导致错误答案的解；基于多样性的方法则选择遵循不同推理路径的部分解，从而更可能覆盖不同的最终解。这两者之间的张力是探索与利用的典型体现，但此前极少有剪枝研究直接暴露这一权衡，更不用说对其进行优化。本文引入一种剪枝过程，通过直接优化所选解池的pass@$k$来解决这一权衡。具体而言，该方法选择解池以最大化至少一个部分解在完成后续生成后得到正确答案的概率。由于该目标同时奖励高质量的部分解并惩罚它们之间的冗余，质量与多样性自然由准则本身平衡，而非依赖额外的临时设计。在八个开源权重推理模型上，我们的方法优于现有的基于质量与基于多样性的剪枝策略。当剪枝过程保留适度数量的部分解以继续生成时，性能提升尤为显著，凸显了在剪枝过程中直接平衡质量与多样性的价值。

summary: Wrong automatic routing of an IT support ticket can cost more than human triage. We evaluate cost-aware abstention as an offline, cost-conditional readiness assessment: select a routing policy on calibration data under explicit costs, then evaluate that frozen policy once on held-out test data. On a public 47,837-ticket, eight-class corpus, we compare four trained non-LLM classifiers with four large language models under zero- and few-shot prompting. Under the illustrative cost model (c_ok, c_triage, c_wrong) = (0, 1, 5), TF-IDF with logistic regression and a threshold of 0.60 selected on calibration reduces test cost from 0.763 to 0.472, a 38.1% relative reduction (paired ratio-bootstrap 95% CI [35.7%, 40.4%]), while lowering wrong routes from 15.3% to 3.5%. Frozen calibration-selected policies also beat both always-route and always-defer on held-out test data in 14 of 16 settings in a post-hoc cost-parameter analysis. The strongest prompted configuration reaches 0.477 accuracy on a stratified 1,000-ticket test subset, versus 0.879 for fine-tuned DistilBERT on the same tickets. Isotonic lowers expected calibration error without reliably improving discrimination: GPT-4o-mini few-shot has one confidence value before and after recalibration and correctness AUROC 0.500. We therefore report correctness AUROC and tie-aware risk-coverage area alongside ECE. At the analytically derived break-even probability 0.80, seven prompted configurations defer all tickets; Haiku few-shot routes only 19/1,000. An LLM-only agreement control and margin/entropy rejection baselines further separate calibration from discrimination. The findings are scoped to this dataset, prompt design, model endpoints, and illustrative costs; the work is an evaluation framework, not a new abstention algorithm or universal deployment certification.
title: Cost-Aware Abstention for LLM-Based IT Ticket Classification

title_translated: 面向基于LLM的IT工单分类的成本感知拒答机制
summary_translated: 错误的自动路由IT支持工单成本可能高于人工分诊。我们评估成本感知拒答作为一种离线、成本条件下的准备度评估：在校准数据上根据显式成本选择路由策略，然后在保留的测试数据上一次性评估该冻结策略。在一个包含47,837个工单、八类的公开语料库上，我们将四种训练好的非LLM分类器与四种大型语言模型在零样本和少样本提示下进行比较。在示例成本模型（c_ok, c_triage, c_wrong）=（0, 1, 5）下，TF-IDF结合逻辑回归并在校准数据上设定0.60阈值，使测试成本从0.763降至0.472，相对降低38.1%（配对比率-bootstrap 95%置信区间[35.7%, 40.4%]），同时错误路由率从15.3%降至3.5%。在事后成本参数分析中，冻结的校准选择策略在16个设置中的14个上优于始终路由和始终拒答。最强提示配置在分层的1,000个工单测试子集上达到0.477准确率，而微调后的DistilBERT在同一数据上为0.879。等距校准降低了期望校准误差，但未可靠提升判别能力：GPT-4o-mini少样本提示在再校准前后仅有一次置信度值，正确性AUROC为0.500。因此，我们报告正确性AUROC和考虑关联风险覆盖面积，同时报告ECE。在理论推导的临界概率0.80处，七个提示配置全部拒绝工单；Haiku少样本仅路由19/1,000。仅LLM一致性和边际/熵拒绝基线进一步区分了校准与判别。研究结果限于该数据集、提示设计、模型端点和示例成本；本工作是一个评估框架，而非新的拒答算法或通用部署认证。

summary: \emph{Continuous-space} attacks find prompts that trigger malicious behaviors, such as overthinking, in black-box LLMs by sampling or optimizing over a low-dimensional Gaussian latent space and decoding it to text through a \emph{random mapping} and nearest-token lookup. Because the random mapping is not learned from language, its prompts can be highly unnatural, and as such easily detectable through input guardrails, and the risk estimates they yield are not grounded in natural prompts. In this paper, we demonstrate that the same continuous latent-space framework can be coupled directly to a learned generative distribution over language, a continuous diffusion language model (dLLM), which removes the artificial random mapping while preserving the standard-Gaussian latent formulation and the downstream sampling or optimization procedure. We evaluate this approach under two settings: sampling-based estimation using \emph{RareTrap} and optimization-based search using \emph{ThinkTrap}. We find that character-level perplexity drops from $10^3$--$10^7$ to 3--5 in RareTrap and from 20--28 to 4.3--5.4 in ThinkTrap. We also find that model risk estimates can differ by an order of magnitude across the two mappings.
title: Diffusion Language Models for Perplexity-Aware Black-Box Attacks
title_translated: 用于困惑度感知黑盒攻击的扩散语言模型
summary_translated: 连续空间攻击通过在低维高斯潜空间中采样或优化，并通过随机映射和最近词查找解码为文本，来寻找触发恶意行为（如过度思考）的提示，适用于黑盒LLM。由于随机映射未从语言中学习，其生成的提示往往极不自然，极易被输入防护机制检测到，且由此产生的风险估计缺乏自然提示的基础。本文证明，相同的连续潜空间框架可直接与语言上的学习生成分布结合，即连续扩散语言模型（dLLM），从而消除人为的随机映射，同时保留标准高斯潜变量形式和下游采样或优化流程。我们在两种设置下评估该方法：基于采样的估计使用RareTrap，基于优化的搜索使用ThinkTrap。结果显示，在RareTrap中，字符级困惑度从10^3–10^7降至3–5；在ThinkTrap中，从20–28降至4.3–5.4。我们还发现，两种映射下的模型风险估计可相差一个数量级。

summary: Text-to-speech (TTS) is usually evaluated by transcribing its output with an automatic speech recognition (ASR) system, so the word error rate also counts recognizer errors. We measure these errors on human recordings of the test sentences. On LibriSpeech and FLEURS, the evaluation recognizer misses 33-67% of very rare words even in human speech, and all three recognizers miss 22-42%. Checking every word with two more recognizer families lowers the apparent TTS error on words that at least one recognizer hears two- to three-fold (very rare LibriSpeech words: from 10-13% to 3-5%), yet very rare words remain the hardest. Ignoring words the recognizer misses in human speech is biased: the other recognizers find TTS errors far more often on these words (4-6% vs. 0.2-0.3%) and overturn about half of the errors this mask keeps. As half of the remaining adjudicated errors may be spelling variants, a listening test is needed.
title: Measuring the Verifier's Floor: How Much Apparent Rare-Word Text-to-Speech Error Is ASR Error?
title_translated: 衡量验证者的下限：有多少看似罕见词的文本到语音错误其实是ASR错误？
summary_translated: 文本到语音（TTS）通常通过使用自动语音识别（ASR）系统转录其输出来进行评估，因此词错误率也包含了识别器的错误。我们在人类录制的测试句子上测量这些错误。在LibriSpeech和FLEURS数据集上，评估用的识别器即使在人类语音中也会遗漏33%-67%的极罕见词汇，且所有三个识别器都遗漏了22%-42%的词汇。通过使用另外两个识别器家族检查每个词，使得至少有一个识别器能听到的罕见词的TTS错误率降低了两到三倍（例如极罕见的LibriSpeech词汇错误率从10%-13%降至3%-5%），但极罕见词仍然是最难处理的部分。忽略识别器在人类语音中遗漏的词汇会造成偏差：其他识别器在这些词上发现TTS错误的频率远高于此（4%-6% vs. 0.2%-0.3%），并推翻了约一半被该掩码掩盖的错误。由于剩余可判定错误中有一半可能是拼写变体，因此需要进行听觉测试。

summary: Systems that aim to help a user engage with viewpoints other than their own have to decide how different those viewpoints should be. Viewpoints are mainly represented on a scalar scale, too coarse to distinguish viewpoints that disagree with the user about different things. We introduce a selection policy in which a bandit sets how far viewpoints may sit from the user, and the policy selects the most novel viewpoint within that bound. We vary only its stance encoder, comparing a scalar score with Perspectivized Stance Vectors, which break a position into separate stances on concepts. We integrate it inside a dialog system and run a between-subjects study (N=63). Concept-level stance produces more varied exposure sequences and broader coverage of the topic's positions, but does not change how deeply users justify viewpoints or how accurately they reconstruct them. Finally, we analyze user--viewpoint relations at the concept level, showing that users reconstruct a viewpoint least accurately on concepts that one side took no position on, rather than on concepts where the two disagreed. Our findings open up opportunities for dialog systems that support engagement with alternative viewpoints by acting on which concepts a user and a viewpoint disagree on, rather than on distance alone.
title: How Different, or Different How? Stance Granularity in Viewpoint Selection for Dialog Systems that Engage Users with Alternative Views
title_translated: 有多不同，或如何不同？对话系统中观点选择的立场粒度研究
summary_translated: 旨在帮助用户接触与其自身观点不同的观点的系统，必须决定这些观点应有多大的差异。目前的观点主要以标量尺度表示，过于粗略，无法区分在不同方面与用户相左的观点。我们提出一种选择策略，其中强化学习中的“老虎机”机制设定观点与用户之间的距离范围，而策略则在此范围内选择最具新颖性的观点。我们仅改变立场编码器，将标量评分与“视角化立场向量”进行对比，后者将立场分解为对各个概念的独立立场。我们将该策略集成到对话系统中，并开展一项被试间实验（N=63）。结果显示，概念级立场生成了更丰富的观点暴露序列，并覆盖了更广泛的观点范围，但并未改变用户论证观点的深度或重构观点的准确性。最后，我们从概念层面分析用户与观点的关系，发现用户在一方未表态的概念上重构观点最不准确，而非在双方存在分歧的概念上。我们的研究结果为对话系统支持用户接触替代观点提供了新思路，即基于用户与观点在哪些概念上存在分歧，而非仅依赖距离。

summary: Given an unseen graph, a start node, $s$, and an end node, $t$, can a language model generate the shortest path from $s$ to $t$? Prior work has found that models fail to learn this task as the graphs scale. We show that this failure has two causes: the supervision signal and the tokenization. First, we theoretically establish and empirically demonstrate the effectiveness of multi-token prediction (MTP), and show that the benefits of MTP are topologically agnostic. Second, we introduce alternative tokenizations and show that the two causes are orthogonal. Using these methods, we break through the scaling wall observed by prior work, consistently and stably learning to solve the task at scales far beyond previous limits.
title: Multi-Token Prediction and Alternative Tokenization Improve Learning Latent Multi-Hop Graph Search at Scale

title_translated: 多标记预测与替代分词提升大规模隐式多跳图搜索的学习能力
summary_translated: 面对一个未见过的图、起始节点 $s$ 和目标节点 $t$，语言模型能否生成从 $s$ 到 $t$ 的最短路径？先前的研究发现，随着图规模增大，模型难以学会这一任务。我们指出这种失败有两个原因：监督信号和分词方式。首先，我们从理论上建立并实证证明了多标记预测（MTP）的有效性，并表明MTP的优势具有拓扑无关性。其次，我们引入了替代分词方法，并证明这两个因素是正交的。结合这两种方法，我们突破了先前研究观察到的扩展瓶颈，在远超以往极限的规模下，稳定且一致地学习解决该任务。

summary: Vector quantization (VQ), in particular lattice-based methods, offer strong rate-distortion trade-offs for low-bit large language models (LLMs), yet their behavior under quantization-aware training (VQ-QAT) remains poorly understood. We scale lattice VQ-QAT to billion-parameter LLMs and multi-billion-token training regimes, and introduce SQuAT, a shape-gain VQ-QAT approach trained with a separate straight-through estimator (STE) for the shape and gain. SQuAT decomposes weights into direction and magnitude: normalized directions are quantized using an $E_8$-derived spherical codebook, while gains are quantized independently with low-bit scalar quantizers. We show that, unlike a standard STE applied to the full quantizer, which ignores the shape-gain structure, these separate STEs induce tangent-space updates for directions, yielding an implicit form of spherical (Riemannian) optimization. To enable scalability, we develop a distributed exact nearest-neighbor assignment scheme, in which workers quantize disjoint weight blocks and communicate only discrete indices, reducing VQ-QAT training time by 12.8$\times$ and allowing us to scale it to 10B tokens. Across instruction-tuned LLaMA-3.2-1B/3B, Qwen3-4B, and base Qwen3-1.7B, SQuAT consistently outperforms standard VQ-QAT STE under identical quantizers and initialization, and achieves SOTA VQ-QAT accuracy.
title: SQuAT: Spherical Lattice Vector Quantization-Aware Training
authors: Tycho F. A. van der Ouderaa
title_translated: SQuAT：球面格点向量量化感知训练
summary_translated: 向量量化（VQ），尤其是基于格点的方法，为低比特大语言模型（LLMs）提供了优异的率失真权衡，但其在量化感知训练（VQ-QAT）下的行为仍不清晰。我们将格点VQ-QAT扩展至十亿参数级别的LLMs和数十亿token的训练场景，并提出SQuAT，一种基于形状-增益结构的VQ-QAT方法，采用独立的直通估计器（STE）分别处理形状和增益。SQuAT将权重分解为方向和幅度：归一化方向使用由 $E_8$ 导出的球面码本进行量化，而增益则使用低比特标量量化器独立量化。我们证明，与直接应用于整个量化器的标准STE不同，这种分离的STE会诱导方向的切空间更新，从而实现隐式的球面（黎曼）优化。为实现可扩展性，我们开发了一种分布式精确最近邻分配方案，各工作节点量化不重叠的权重块，仅通信离散索引，使VQ-QAT训练时间减少12.8倍，并成功将其扩展至100亿token。在指令微调的LLaMA-3.2-1B/3B、Qwen3-4B和基础版Qwen3-1.7B模型上，SQuAT在相同量化器和初始化条件下始终优于标准VQ-QAT STE，并实现了当前最优的VQ-QAT精度。

summary: Visual document understanding is essential for acquiring knowledge from visually rich documents and is attracting growing research interest. Existing surveys emphasize architectures or technical approaches, with limited attention to how task bottlenecks shape technical choices and research priorities. We present a task-centric survey that decomposes long-document visual question answering (VQA) into four components: document parsing, evidence organization and retrieval, generator organization and learning, and evaluation. For each, we develop a fine-grained taxonomy and trace motivations, technical responses, and cross-component connections. We focus on explicit retrieval while covering direct reading. Our temporal analysis traces expanding priorities from multimodal content understanding to sufficient, high-fidelity evidence acquisition and sustained evidence management. We outline future directions in evidence sufficiency, verifiable and correctable understanding, and budget-aware coordination, with an outlook on continual document understanding.
title: A Task-Centric Survey of Long-Document Visual Question Answering: Taxonomy, Evolution, and Future Directions
title_translated: 面向长文档视觉问答的任务中心综述：分类体系、演进历程与未来方向
summary_translated: 视觉文档理解对于从视觉信息丰富的文档中获取知识至关重要，正吸引越来越多的研究关注。现有综述侧重于架构或技术方法，较少关注任务瓶颈如何塑造技术选择和研究重点。我们提出一种任务中心的综述，将长文档视觉问答（VQA）分解为四个组成部分：文档解析、证据组织与检索、生成器组织与学习，以及评估。针对每一部分，我们构建了细粒度的分类体系，并追溯其动机、技术响应及跨组件关联。我们重点关注显式检索，同时涵盖直接阅读。时间分析揭示了研究重点从多模态内容理解扩展到充分且高保真的证据获取与持续证据管理。我们展望了未来方向，包括证据充分性、可验证且可修正的理解，以及预算感知的协调机制，并对持续文档理解进行了展望。

summary: Many LLM agents maintain external persistent memory and derive additional state from past interactions, such as summaries. Deleting an original memory record therefore need not remove information carried by its descendants. We introduce AfterDeleteBench, a controlled behavioral audit for this failure mode in fixed-weight LLM agents. For each synthetic secret, we compare an exposed-then-deleted agent with an otherwise matched agent that was never exposed to the secret, allowing post-deletion recovery to be attributed to the original exposure. In our primary setting, a single query recovers the deleted secret from Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct in roughly two thirds of cases, while matched never-exposed controls have zero recovery. Crucially, recovery does not require a surviving verbatim copy: when the complete secret string is absent and only separately stored components remain under a public composition rule, exact reconstruction succeeds in 62-99% of cases across Qwen, Mistral, and Phi-3. We also show that the response interface is part of the measurement system: target-bearing replies can be scored as failures when the requested format and parser are misaligned. Finally, we separate reconstruction from write-back and fresh-session recall. Provenance-aware closure eliminates observed recovery in the tested positive-baseline settings, whereas an exact-literal write filter blocks reinsertion but cannot erase information already present. Together, these results show that source deletion should be evaluated behaviorally at the level of the agent and its memory system, not only as a storage operation.
title: AfterDeleteBench: Auditing Post-Deletion Information Persistence in LLM Agents
title_translated: AfterDeleteBench：评估大语言模型智能体在删除后的信息持久性
summary_translated: 许多大语言模型智能体维持外部持久记忆，并从过往交互中衍生出额外状态，例如摘要。因此，删除原始记忆记录并不一定消除其后代所携带的信息。我们提出了AfterDeleteBench，一种针对固定权重大语言模型智能体中此类失效模式的受控行为审计方法。对于每个合成的秘密，我们将一个曾暴露后被删除的智能体与一个从未接触过该秘密的匹配对照组进行比较，从而将删除后的信息恢复归因于原始暴露。在主要设置中，仅通过一次查询即可在约三分之二的情况下从Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct中恢复已删除的秘密，而未暴露的对照组则完全无法恢复。关键的是，恢复并不需要保留完整的原文副本：当完整密文字符串已不存在，仅以公开组合规则分别存储的组件仍存在时，Qwen、Mistral和Phi-3在62%-99%的情况下仍能实现精确重构。我们还发现响应接口是测量系统的一部分：当请求格式与解析器不匹配时，含有目标的回答可被判定为失败。最后，我们区分了重构与写回、以及新会话中的召回。具有溯源意识的闭合机制在测试的正向基线设置中消除了观察到的恢复现象，而精确字面写入过滤器虽能阻止重新插入，却无法清除已存在的信息。这些结果表明，源删除应从智能体及其记忆系统的整体行为层面进行评估，而不仅仅是作为存储操作。

summary: Memory enables language agents to carry useful distinctions from past experience into future decisions. Its value depends on which distinctions survive, whether a bounded agent can use them, and what can be recovered or revised as demands evolve. We develop a decision-theoretic framework that follows this value from raw history through persistent state, operational use, and costly recovery and revision. Original and retained value are expressed in units of avoided task loss; risk-cost frontiers describe attainable recovery and preservation across uses. Unknown demand yields value profiles, while interactive feedback changes the distribution of future work. A cost-aware simulation condition and five minimal counterexamples expose the roles of information timing, retrieval access, component interaction, feedback and demand uncertainty. In particular, a pointer with zero mutual information about the answer can still reduce the cost of exact recovery. Diagnostics on LoCoMo, a two-project update task and longitudinal cases exhibit failures of preservation, use and measurement. At fixed retrieved evidence, a saved ledger changes subsequent answers; at fixed agent outputs, an evaluator revision changes scores. The framework connects these distinctions to operational risk bounds and testable principles for allocating memory, preserving recovery options and revising evidence dependencies.
title: The Value of Memory in Language Agents
title_translated: 语言智能体中记忆的价值
summary_translated: 记忆使语言智能体能够将过去经验中的有用区分带入未来的决策中。其价值取决于哪些区分得以保留、有限智能体能否使用它们，以及随着需求演变，哪些内容可以被恢复或修订。我们构建了一个决策论框架，追踪从原始历史到持久状态、实际使用以及代价高昂的恢复与修订过程中价值的演变。原始价值与保留价值均以避免任务损失的单位表示；风险-成本边界描述了在不同用途下可达到的恢复与保存水平。未知需求产生价值分布，而交互式反馈则改变未来工作的分布。通过成本感知的模拟条件及五个最小反例，揭示了信息时机、检索访问、组件交互、反馈和需求不确定性的作用。特别地，即使指针与答案之间互信息为零，仍可降低精确恢复的成本。对LoCoMo（双项目更新任务）和纵向案例的诊断显示了保存、使用和测量方面的失败。在固定检索证据下，保存的账本会改变后续回答；在固定智能体输出下，评估者修订会改变评分。该框架将这些区分与操作风险边界联系起来，并提出可测试的原则，用于分配记忆、保留恢复选项和修订证据依赖关系。

summary: While arousal can be reliably predicted from musical audio, emotional valence remains difficult to model due to its subjective and context-dependent nature. In this work, we investigate the potential of in-context learning (ICL) with large language models to advance continuous valence and arousal prediction. Rather than predicting emotion scores directly, our framework leverages contextual demonstrations from an auxiliary dataset to refine the initial predictions produced by a small, task-specific base model. We systematically evaluate a text-based ICL variant using lyrics and generated audio captions, alongside a multimodal variant that incorporates raw audio signals. Using the entire MER60 dataset strictly as a held-out test set, our experiments demonstrate substantial performance gains, particularly for valence. Text-based ICL improves the valence $R^2$ from 0.110 to 0.427 with 80 demonstration shots, while the multimodal variant achieves 0.346 with only 10 shots. These findings suggest that training-free ICL offers an effective inference-time strategy for current language models to predict continuous music emotion.
title: Predicting Music Valence and Arousal via Textual and Multimodal In-Context Learning in Large Language Models
title_translated: 通过文本与多模态上下文学习预测音乐情绪的兴奋度与唤醒度
summary_translated: 虽然唤醒度可以从音乐音频中可靠预测，但情绪效价由于其主观性和情境依赖性，仍难以建模。本文研究了大语言模型中上下文学习（ICL）在推进连续效价与唤醒度预测方面的潜力。我们不直接预测情绪分数，而是利用辅助数据集中的上下文示例来优化由小型专用基础模型生成的初始预测。我们系统评估了基于文本的ICL变体（使用歌词和生成的音频描述）以及融合原始音频信号的多模态变体。严格将整个MER60数据集用作保留测试集，实验表明性能显著提升，尤其在效价预测方面。基于文本的ICL在80个示范样本下将效价的$R^2$从0.110提升至0.427，而多模态变体仅用10个样本即达到0.346。这些发现表明，无需训练的ICL为当前语言模型提供了一种有效的推理时策略，用于预测连续音乐情绪。

summary: Deep research agents synthesize open-web evidence into long reports, but current benchmarks do not evaluate research centered on a source video. We introduce Video-Centered Deep Research Report Generation. Given a video and user request, an agent identifies research questions, retrieves external multimodal evidence, and produces an interactive report linked to relevant video moments. This task has direct practical value because it helps users locate relevant moments, verify claims, reproduce demonstrated procedures, and make informed decisions from video content. We present a skill-based workflow and OmniDR-Bench for this task. For evaluation, we propose Omni Atomic Rubric Trees (Omni-ARTs). Each tree contains three dimensions, 23 shared directions, and task-specific atomic binary criteria. The directions test audiovisual grounding, multimodal evidence use, and interactive presentation. Audited Rubric Construction (ARC) builds these trees through independent evidence collection, automated checks, behavioral calibration, and iterative human review. OmniDR-Bench contains 50 Chinese and English tasks across 19 realworld subcategories. It includes 6,414 criteria. Across 18 agent configurations, the best system scores 63.3 out of 100. Current agents still need broader content coverage, stronger causal and logical analysis across modalities, and more accurate citation support. We further analyze models, harnesses, skill configurations, video categories, and research trajectories. The code and data are released at https://github.com/marinero4972/OmniDR-Bench.
title: Beyond Watching and Searching: Benchmarking Agents for Video-centered Deep Research Reports
title_translated: 超越观看与搜索：面向视频中心深度研究报告的智能体基准评测
summary_translated: 深度研究智能体将开放网络证据整合为长篇报告，但现有基准未能评估以视频为核心的研究任务。我们引入“视频中心深度研究报告生成”任务。给定一段视频和用户请求，智能体需识别研究问题、检索外部多模态证据，并生成链接到相关视频片段的交互式报告。该任务具有直接的实际价值，帮助用户定位相关内容、验证主张、复现演示流程并基于视频内容做出明智决策。我们提出了基于技能的工作流和OmniDR-Bench基准。评估方面，我们设计了Omni原子评分树（Omni-ARTs），每棵树包含三个维度、23个共享方向和任务特定的原子二元标准。方向涵盖视听对齐、多模态证据使用和交互式呈现。审计评分构建（ARC）通过独立证据收集、自动化检查、行为校准和迭代人工评审构建这些树。OmniDR-Bench包含50个中英文任务，覆盖19个真实世界子类别，共6,414项评估标准。在18种智能体配置中，最佳系统得分为63.3/100。当前智能体仍需更广泛的内容覆盖、更强的跨模态因果与逻辑分析能力，以及更准确的引用支持。我们进一步分析了模型、工具链、技能配置、视频类别和研究轨迹。代码与数据已发布于https://github.com/marinero4972/OmniDR-Bench。

summary: Procedural mistake recognition requires identifying deviations from valid multi-step activities. We study post-completion recognition from videos with benchmark-provided step boundaries. We introduce PRISM (Procedural mistake Recognition via Interpretable Semantic Modeling), which grounds video segments in language and maps their descriptions to procedural states using a lightweight hidden Markov model trained on correct executions. Reference alignment and semantic checks identify errors in step content and order. To support evaluation across heterogeneous benchmarks, we map dataset-specific annotations to four edit-based error types: insertion, deletion, substitution, and transposition. Across three benchmarks, we compare gold and VLM-generated descriptions in raw, semantic-role, and action-object forms. Decoder controls show consistent gains from the trained local decoder over nearest-candidate matching, with additional, dataset-dependent benefits from sequence decoding. Semantic role labeling improves Any-F1 in all six matched grounded comparisons, although the gains vary across datasets and do not translate into uniform improvements under separate configuration selection. These results establish language grounding as an effective interface for explicit procedural mistake reasoning and characterize the contributions of representation and decoding.
title: Through a PRISM, Clearly: Step-Sequence Reasoning for Mistake Recognition in Procedural Videos
title_translated: 透过棱镜，清晰可见：基于步骤序列推理的程序视频错误识别
summary_translated: 程序错误识别需要识别与有效多步活动相偏离的情况。我们研究了在基准提供的步骤边界条件下，完成后的错误识别。我们提出了PRISM（基于可解释语义建模的程序错误识别），将视频片段与语言进行对齐，并利用在正确执行过程上训练的轻量级隐马尔可夫模型，将描述映射到程序状态。参考对齐与语义检查可识别步骤内容与顺序中的错误。为支持在异构基准间的评估，我们将数据集特定标注映射为四种基于编辑的错误类型：插入、删除、替换和置换。在三个基准上，我们比较了黄金标注与视觉语言模型生成的描述在原始、语义角色和动作-对象形式下的表现。解码控制显示，经过训练的局部解码器相比最近候选匹配具有一致优势，且在某些数据集上额外受益于序列解码。语义角色标注在所有六组配对的接地比较中提升了Any-F1，尽管增益在不同数据集间差异较大，且在独立配置选择下并未带来统一提升。这些结果确立了语言对齐作为显式程序错误推理的有效接口，并刻画了表示与解码的贡献。

summary: Policy enforcement for LLM agents has shifted from single-turn content moderation to compound, application-specific policies evaluated over multi-turn transcripts and tool-call trajectories. Fine-tuned guardrail models are efficient but degrade on compound policies, and while LLM-as-a-judge approaches achieve higher accuracy, they incur high inference cost and tend to produce unstable predictions. Neurosymbolic methods offer a natural alternative, decomposing the policy into narrow neural decisions composed under explicit logic. However, existing symbolic layers lack the required expressiveness and are optimized against fixed data rather than the policy itself. To address this, we introduce SCOPE, which compiles a policy into an executable program of neural predicates executed by small models, deterministic extractors, and code that composes their outputs. The program is optimized jointly with its training data, using adversarial generation of counterexamples that target where the program deviates from the policy. We evaluate SCOPE on a benchmark of real-world policy tasks against prompt optimization, task decomposition, and workflow generation methods, achieving the highest average accuracy across tasks and models. Programs optimized with the weakest executor transfer to other models without further optimization. This allows them to be deployed in production on inexpensive models, where they reach accuracy comparable to frontier reasoning models. Unlike these monolithic models, SCOPE produces substantially more stable predictions, and each verdict is interpretable through the predicate outputs that produced it. Additionally, we validate the key components of our method through an ablation study. SCOPE thus enables reliable, interpretable, and efficient policy enforcement at production scale.
title: SCOPE: Compiling Natural-Language Policies into Neurosymbolic Predicate Programs
title_translated: SCOPE：将自然语言策略编译为神经符号谓词程序
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体的策略执行已从单轮内容审核转向基于多轮对话和工具调用轨迹评估的复合、应用特定策略。微调的护栏模型虽高效，但在复合策略上性能下降；而使用LLM作为评判者的方法虽然准确率更高，但推理成本高且预测不稳定。神经符号方法提供了一种自然替代方案，将策略分解为在显式逻辑下组合的窄范围神经决策。然而，现有符号层缺乏必要的表达能力，且针对固定数据而非策略本身进行优化。为此，我们提出SCOPE，它将策略编译为由小型模型、确定性提取器和代码组成的可执行神经谓词程序，这些代码组合输出结果。程序与其训练数据联合优化，利用对抗性生成反例来针对性地修复程序与策略之间的偏差。我们在真实世界策略任务基准上对SCOPE进行了评估，对比提示优化、任务分解和工作流生成方法，结果显示其在各类任务和模型上的平均准确率最高。即使使用最弱执行器优化的程序也能无需进一步优化即迁移到其他模型上运行。这使得它们可在低成本模型上部署，并达到与前沿推理模型相当的准确率。与这些整体模型不同，SCOPE产生的预测更加稳定，每个判断均可通过生成它的谓词输出进行解释。此外，我们通过消融研究验证了方法的关键组件。因此，SCOPE实现了大规模生产环境下的可靠、可解释且高效的策略执行。

summary: Personal agents need to draw on long-term interaction history to retrieve and apply external knowledge suited to a user's current request. Even an answer grounded in relevant documents can be unsuitable when it overlooks the user's circumstances. This creates two connected challenges: using historical conditions to identify the knowledge needed for a new request, and applying that knowledge to the user's situation. Existing benchmarks advance memory recall, personalized retrieval, and memory-guided action, while the joint evaluation of these two challenges remains underexplored. We introduce ColaBench, a synthetic benchmark in health and daily living, with 349 tasks across 10 Profiles and a knowledge base of 13,033 documents. Its Evidence Graph connects personal conditions to their disclosures across public interaction sessions, records prior document exposure, and links answer requirements to personal and newly acquired document evidence. We also introduce MemKB, which uses state summaries to inform queries and rule application, and memory-document links to retrieve knowledge associated with the user's history. MemKB achieves 86.25% Accuracy with an average of 4.07 interaction rounds per task. Task-level analysis finds larger gains on tasks integrating information across multiple historical Facts; error analysis further identifies unsupported personal assumptions and rule misapplication as obstacles to using retrieved evidence. ColaBench provides traceable tasks and an evaluation framework for studying how memory guides knowledge acquisition and rule application.
title: ColaBench: Evaluating Memory-Guided Knowledge Acquisition in Personal Agents
title_translated: ColaBench：评估个人智能体中的记忆引导知识获取
summary_translated: 个人智能体需要利用长期交互历史来检索并应用符合用户当前请求的外部知识。即使答案基于相关文档，若忽略用户情境也可能不适用。这带来了两个相互关联的挑战：利用历史条件识别新请求所需的知识，并将该知识应用于用户的具体情况。现有基准在记忆召回、个性化检索和记忆引导行动方面有所进展，但对这两个挑战的联合评估仍处于探索阶段。我们提出了ColaBench，一个涵盖健康与日常生活领域的合成基准，包含10个用户档案、349项任务以及13,033份文档的知识库。其证据图将个人状况与其在公开交互会话中的披露相连接，记录先前的文档暴露情况，并将答案需求与个人及新获取的文档证据关联起来。我们还引入了MemKB，利用状态摘要指导查询与规则应用，并通过记忆-文档链接检索与用户历史相关的知识。MemKB在每项任务上平均需4.07轮交互，达到86.25%的准确率。任务层面分析发现，在整合多个历史事实的任务中提升更显著；错误分析进一步指出，未被支持的个人假设和规则误用是使用检索证据的主要障碍。ColaBench提供了可追溯的任务和评估框架，用于研究记忆如何引导知识获取与规则应用。

summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate UML class diagrams from natural language requirements, but hallucinations may compromise the correctness and completeness of the resulting diagrams. Existing evaluations mostly assess the final diagram, without examining the intermediate traces of reasoning-capable LLMs, which can reveal where these hallucinations arise. We develop an empirical taxonomy of eleven hallucination sub-types organised into three dimensions: Prompt Faithfulness (deviations between requirements and reasoning), Code Faithfulness (discrepancies between reasoning and generated PlantUML code), and Reasoning Quality (problems within the reasoning). The taxonomy was derived from 60 manually annotated DeepSeek-R1 traces, applied to 120 further DeepSeek-R1 traces through a dual-LLM annotation pipeline, and examined on 20 DeepSeek-V4-Pro traces. Code Faithfulness was the most frequent dimension for DeepSeek-R1 in both datasets, whereas Prompt Faithfulness dominated for DeepSeek-V4-Pro, suggesting model-dependent failure patterns. In the manually annotated traces, reasoning-trace length showed no significant monotonic association with hallucination frequency, whereas requirement complexity was negatively associated with it, particularly for Prompt Faithfulness errors. In a mitigation experiment on 13 Golden UML ModelSet cases with three Qwen3-based models, adding Prompt Faithfulness and Reasoning Quality constraints to the generation prompt raised the pooled mean F1 score by 4.0 percentage points, whereas a post-hoc Code Faithfulness review provided no consistent further benefit. Relationship modelling remained the lowest-scoring element throughout. These results suggest that localising hallucinations within the generation process can inform targeted, prompt-based mitigation. Whether these findings generalise beyond the DeepSeek and Qwen3 model families remains to be tested.
title: Tracing Hallucinations in LLM Reasoning for UML Class Diagram Generation: An Empirical Taxonomy and Mitigation Study
title_translated: 追踪LLM推理中UML类图生成的幻觉：一项实证分类与缓解研究
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）能够从自然语言需求生成UML类图，但幻觉可能损害生成图的正确性和完整性。现有评估大多仅关注最终图的结果，而未考察具备推理能力的LLM的中间推理轨迹，这些轨迹可揭示幻觉发生的源头。我们构建了一个包含十一类子类型的实证幻觉分类体系，分为三个维度：提示忠实度（需求与推理之间的偏差）、代码忠实度（推理与生成的PlantUML代码之间的差异）以及推理质量（推理过程内部的问题）。该分类体系基于60条手动标注的DeepSeek-R1推理轨迹，通过双LLM标注流程应用于120条额外的DeepSeek-R1轨迹，并在20条DeepSeek-V4-Pro轨迹上进行检验。结果显示，在两个数据集中，DeepSeek-R1的代码忠实度问题最为频繁，而DeepSeek-V4-Pro则以提示忠实度问题为主，表明失败模式具有模型依赖性。在手动标注的轨迹中，推理轨迹长度与幻觉频率之间无显著单调关系，而需求复杂度与幻觉频率呈负相关，尤其在提示忠实度错误中表现明显。在13个黄金UML模型集案例的缓解实验中，向生成提示中加入提示忠实度和推理质量约束，使合并后的平均F1分数提升了4.0个百分点；而事后代码忠实度审查则未带来一致的进一步收益。关系建模始终是得分最低的环节。这些结果表明，定位生成过程中幻觉的来源可为针对性的提示级缓解提供依据。这些发现是否适用于DeepSeek和Qwen3以外的模型家族仍有待验证。

summary: Fine-grained image-text retrieval requires a model not only to assess global semantic consistency between an image and a text, but also to model visual evidence for local textual semantics, including objects, attributes, quantities, actions, and relations, so as to distinguish semantically similar candidates. Existing methods commonly use fixed image patches, detected regions, or text tokens as the basic matching units and then aggregate local interactions through max pooling, cross attention, or similarity accumulation. Such strategies remain limited in semantic unit construction and global matching consistency. This paper proposes a hierarchical fine-grained cross-modal alignment framework, termed HFCMA. The framework progressively transforms low-level patch and token representations into adaptive visual regions and textual phrases, and then performs structured region-phrase matching within a global retrieval scoring process. Specifically, HFCMA first adopts dynamic granularity discovery (DGD) to aggregate raw patches and tokens into semantically compact visual regions and textual phrases. It then formulates region-phrase matching as an entropy-regularized optimal transport problem, thereby estimating a structured alignment matrix under global marginal constraints. To reduce background noise and local semantic drift, HFCMA further introduces background debiasing, textual importance weighting, and prototype consistency regularization. Experiments on Flickr30K and MS-COCO show that HFCMA effectively combines dynamic semantic unit construction with OT-based structured matching under a dual-encoder retrieval framework. The resulting fine-grained score provides structured local alignment information for candidate ranking and improves the discrimination of subtle semantic differences.
title: Hierarchical Fine-Grained Cross-Modal Alignment via Dynamic Granularity Discovery and Optimal Transport
